48 // nEBQ is sized for ALL faces (nDOF_mesh_trial_element * nQuadraturePoints_elementBoundary),
49 // not one face, so the immersed-interface facet terms can evaluate va/vb at the quadrature
50 // points of the face they are actually integrating -- see the xB_ref_faces comment in
51 // calculateResidual for why passing the reference *boundary* points directly is wrong.
52 // Degree k of the fitted H/ImH/D polynomials (GfType, the triply-cut composite fits, the edge
53 // fits). Each cut-cell term is sum_q w_q*fit*F, exact when deg F <= k AND k + deg F <= the
54 // element rule's degree. The Gamma_s Nitsche penalty / Robin terms are degree 2p. P1: k=3 with
55 // the 12-point (degree-6) rule. P2: k=4 needs the 16-point (degree-8) rule (qOrder=8); with
56 // the 12-point rule k=3 is kept, which is exact through degree 2p-1=3 and still rate-optimal.
57 static const int nP_fit = (nDOF_trial_element == 6 && nQuadraturePoints_element >= 16) ? 4 : 3;
58 using GfType = GeneralizedFunctions<nSpace, nDOF_trial_element, nP_fit, nQuadraturePoints_element, nDOF_mesh_trial_element * nQuadraturePoints_elementBoundary>;
59 // Degree of the edge-restricted moment-fit Heaviside used by the edge terms (SCIFEM, the
60 // triply-cut correction). The consistency terms are degree 2p-1 and the interior penalty 2p;
61 // the 1D boundary rule (qOrder points) is exact far beyond nP_edge + 2p.
62 static const int nP_edge = nP_fit;
63 // Per-element cache of the equivalent-polynomial/IFEM reconstruction
64 // (gf_s.calculate()/gf_f.calculate()): permutation, cut classification,
65 // the IFEM basis coefficient solve, and the H/ImH/D + VA/VB (+
66 // gradients) evaluated at every quadrature point. None of this depends
67 // on the current solution u -- only on the level-set geometry
68 // (element_phi_s/element_phi_f) and mua/mub/jf -- so it is only
69 // recomputed when ifemGeometryGeneration advances (see
70 // recomputeIFEMGeometry / markIFEMGeometryDirty on the Python side).
71 // Interior (isBoundary=false) and boundary (isBoundary=true) evaluations
72 // populate different internal storage within the same GfType object, so
73 // they are tracked with separate generation/icase arrays.
74 std::vector<GfType> gf_f_cache, gf_s_cache;
75 std::vector<int> gf_s_interior_gen, gf_f_interior_gen, gf_f_boundary_gen;
76 std::vector<int> gf_s_interior_icase, gf_f_interior_icase, gf_f_boundary_icase;
77 // Composite equivalent polynomials for elements cut by BOTH level sets. The product
78 // ImH_f*H_s is not moment-exact on such an element (see .notes/EQUIVALENT_POLYNOMIALS.md
79 // section 7.1); these replace it with one fit per intersected region. Only populated when
80 // icase_s == 0 && icase_f == 0, so every single-level-set element keeps the old path
81 // bit-for-bit.
82 static const int nCompMon = (nP_fit + 1) * (nP_fit + 2) / 2; // monomials up to degree nP_fit
83 std::vector<double> comp_A_cache, comp_B_cache;
84 std::vector<double> comp_DA_cache, comp_DB_cache;
85 std::vector<char> comp_valid;
86 // Gamma_f's OWN Dirac measure, split by Gamma_s's sign: comp_DFm = the masked (solid,
87 // phi_s<0) part, comp_DFa = the active (fluid, phi_s>0) part. Needed for any Dirac-delta
88 // term integrated over Gamma_f on a triply-cut element (e.g. the prescribed-flux-jump
89 // source, [beta du/dn]*D_f) -- using the plain single-curve gf_f.D(0.,0.) there
90 // double-counts whatever part of Gamma_f's chord falls inside the masked-out solid.
91 // Tracked as its own validity flag, not folded into comp_valid: bulk area weights, Gamma_s's
92 // own Dirac measure, and Gamma_f's own Dirac measure are three independently-fitted
93 // quantities that can, in principle, succeed or fail on different degenerate geometries
94 // (see .notes/EQUIVALENT_POLYNOMIALS.md's "track independent flags, not one" rule).
95 std::vector<double> comp_DFm_cache, comp_DFa_cache;
96 std::vector<char> comp_DF_valid;
97 // Amplitude of the flux-jump lift J*psi on each cell, as used in this residual evaluation:
98 // the per-cell J_f from ADR.py minus the flux jump the solution-jump lift j_h already
99 // carries (nonzero only when J_s varies on the cell). Read by the element and face terms.
100 std::vector<double> fluxLiftAmp;
101 int ifemGeometryGeneration = 0;
102 cADR() : nDOF_test_X_trial_element(nDOF_test_element * nDOF_trial_element), ck()

105 inline void ensureIFEMCacheSized(int nElements_global)
106 {
107 if ((int)gf_f_cache.size() == nElements_global)
108 return;
109 gf_f_cache.assign(nElements_global, GfType());
110 gf_s_cache.assign(nElements_global, GfType());
111 fluxLiftAmp.assign(nElements_global, 0.0);
112 gf_s_interior_gen.assign(nElements_global, -1);
113 gf_f_interior_gen.assign(nElements_global, -1);
114 gf_f_boundary_gen.assign(nElements_global, -1);
115 gf_s_interior_icase.assign(nElements_global, 0);
116 gf_f_interior_icase.assign(nElements_global, 0);
117 gf_f_boundary_icase.assign(nElements_global, 0);
118 comp_A_cache.assign((std::size_t)nElements_global * nCompMon, 0.0);
119 comp_B_cache.assign((std::size_t)nElements_global * nCompMon, 0.0);
120 comp_DA_cache.assign((std::size_t)nElements_global * nCompMon, 0.0);
121 comp_DB_cache.assign((std::size_t)nElements_global * nCompMon, 0.0);
122 comp_valid.assign(nElements_global, 0);
123 comp_DFm_cache.assign((std::size_t)nElements_global * nCompMon, 0.0);
124 comp_DFa_cache.assign((std::size_t)nElements_global * nCompMon, 0.0);
125 comp_DF_valid.assign(nElements_global, 0);
126 for (auto &gf : gf_f_cache)
127 gf.useExact = true;
128 for (auto &gf : gf_s_cache)
129 gf.useExact = true;
130 }

132 inline void exteriorNumericalDiffusiveFlux(int *rowptr,
133 int *colind,
134 const int &isDOFBoundary,
135 const int &isDiffusiveFluxBoundary,
136 const double n[nSpace],
137 double *bc_a,
138 const double &bc_u,
139 const double &bc_flux,
140 double *a,
141 const double grad_potential[nSpace],
142 const double &u,
143 const double &penalty,
144 double &flux)
145 {
146 double diffusiveVelocityComponent_I;
147 double penaltyFlux;
148 double max_a;
149 if (isDiffusiveFluxBoundary == 1)
150 {
151 flux = bc_flux;
152 }
153 else if (isDOFBoundary == 1)
154 {
155 flux = 0.0;
156 max_a = 0.0;
157 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++)
158 {
159 diffusiveVelocityComponent_I = 0.0;
160 for (int m = rowptr[I]; m < rowptr[I + 1]; m++)
161 {
162 diffusiveVelocityComponent_I -= a[m] * grad_potential[colind[m]];
163 max_a = fmax(max_a, a[m]);
164 }
165 flux += diffusiveVelocityComponent_I * n[I];
166 }
167 penaltyFlux = max_a * penalty * (u - bc_u);
168 flux += penaltyFlux;
169 }
170 else
171 {
172 std::cerr << "warning, diffusion term with no boundary condition set, setting diffusive flux to 0.0" << std::endl;
173 flux = 0.0;
174 }
175 }

177 inline double ExteriorNumericalDiffusiveFluxJacobian(int *rowptr,
178 int *colind,
179 const int &isDOFBoundary,
180 const int &isDiffusiveFluxBoundary,
181 const double n[nSpace],
182 double *a,
183 const double &v,
184 const double grad_v[nSpace],
185 const double &penalty)
186 {
187 double dvel_I;
188 double tmp = 0.0;
189 double max_a = 0.0;
190 if ((isDiffusiveFluxBoundary == 0) && (isDOFBoundary == 1))
191 {
192 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++)
193 {
194 dvel_I = 0.0;
195 for (int m = rowptr[I]; m < rowptr[I + 1]; m++)
196 {
197 dvel_I -= a[m] * grad_v[colind[m]];
198 max_a = fmax(max_a, a[m]);
199 }
200 tmp += dvel_I * n[I];
201 }
202 tmp += max_a * penalty * v;
203 }
204 return tmp;
205 }

207 inline void calculateSubgridError_tau(const double &elementDiameter,
208 const double &dmt,
209 const double dH[nSpace],
210 double &cfl,
211 double &tau)
212 {
213 double h;
214 double nrm_v;
215 double oneByAbsdt;
216 h = elementDiameter;
217 nrm_v = 0.0;
218 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++)
219 nrm_v += dH[I] * dH[I];
220 nrm_v = sqrt(nrm_v);
221 cfl = nrm_v / h;
222 oneByAbsdt = fabs(dmt);
223 tau = 1.0 / (2.0 * nrm_v / h + oneByAbsdt + 1.0e-8);
224 }
225
226 inline void calculateSubgridError_tau(const double &Ct_sge,
227 const double G[nSpace * nSpace],
228 const double &A0,
229 const double Ai[nSpace],
230 double &tau_v,
231 double &cfl)
232 {
233 double v_d_Gv = 0.0;
234 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++)
235 for (int J = 0; J < nSpace; J++)
236 v_d_Gv += Ai[I] * G[I * nSpace + J] * Ai[J];
237 tau_v = 1.0 / sqrt(Ct_sge * A0 * A0 + v_d_Gv + 1.0e-8);
238 }

240 inline void calculateNumericalDiffusion(const double &shockCapturingDiffusion,
241 const double &elementDiameter,
242 const double &strong_residual,
243 const double grad_u[nSpace],
244 double &numDiff)
245 {
246 double h;
247 double num;
248 double den;
249 double n_grad_u;
250 h = elementDiameter;
251 n_grad_u = 0.0;
252 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++)
253 n_grad_u += grad_u[I] * grad_u[I];
254 num = shockCapturingDiffusion * 0.5 * h * fabs(strong_residual);
255 den = sqrt(n_grad_u) + 1.0e-8;
256 numDiff = num / den;
257 }

259 inline void exteriorNumericalAdvectiveFlux(const int &isDOFBoundary_u,
260 const int &isFluxBoundary_u,
261 const double n[nSpace],
262 const double &bc_u,
263 const double &bc_flux_u,
264 const double &u,
265 const double velocity[nSpace],
266 double &flux)
267 {
268
269 double flow = 0.0;
270 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++)
271 flow += n[I] * velocity[I];
272 if (isDOFBoundary_u == 1)
273 {
274 if (flow >= 0.0)
275 {
276 flux = u * flow;
277 // flux = flow;
278 }
279 else
280 {
281 flux = bc_u * flow;
282 // flux = flow;
283 }
284 }
285 else if (isFluxBoundary_u == 1)
286 {
287 flux = bc_flux_u;
288 }
289 else
290 {
291 if (flow >= 0.0)
292 {
293 flux = u * flow;
294 }
295 else
296 {
297 flux = 0.0;
298 }
299 }
300 // flux = flow;
301 }

340 inline void updateEmbeddedBoundaryTerms(const double embeddedBoundary_penalty,
341 const double dV,
342 double *embeddedBoundary_normal,
343 const double u_s,
344 const double u,
345 const double grad_u[nSpace],
346 const double a,
347 double &r,
348 double &dr,
349 double &ham,
350 double *dham,
351 double *f,
352 double *df,
353 const double D_s)
354 {
355 // todo this doesn't look 1d/3d
356 double outward_normal[nSpace];
357 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++)
358 outward_normal[I] = -embeddedBoundary_normal[I];
359
360 // diffusive flux
361 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++)
362 {
363 ham -= outward_normal[I] * grad_u[I];
364 dham[I] -= D_s * a * outward_normal[I];
365 // Nitsche adjoint consistency
366 f[I] += D_s * a * outward_normal[I] * (u - u_s);
367 df[I] += D_s * a * outward_normal[I];
368 }
369 ham *= D_s * a;
370
371 // Nitsche Dirichlet penalty
372 r += D_s * a * embeddedBoundary_penalty * (u - u_s);
373 dr += D_s * a * embeddedBoundary_penalty;
374 }

376 inline void updateEmbeddedBoundaryRobinTerms(const double h_coeff,
377 const double u_infinity,
378 const double u,
379 double &r,
380 double &dr,
381 const double D_s)
382 {
383 // Robin/convective condition a * du/dn = -h * (u - u_infinity) on Gamma_s (n the
384 // fluid's own outward normal, into the solid): substitute this physical law directly
385 // for the natural boundary term -int a du/dn v ds that integration by parts leaves
386 // behind. Unlike updateEmbeddedBoundaryTerms above, a Robin law is already a natural
387 // condition -- nothing is being enforced weakly -- so it needs no consistency,
388 // symmetry, or penalty construction, only this one reaction-like term.
389 r += D_s * h_coeff * (u - u_infinity);
390 dr += D_s * h_coeff;
391 }

393 inline void updateImmersedBoundaryTerms(const double immersedBoundary_penalty,
394 const double dV,
395 double *immersedBoundary_normal,
396 double x,
397 double y,
398 double z,
399 const double u_s,
400 const double u,
401 const double grad_u[nSpace],
402 const double a,
403 double &r,
404 double &dr,
405 double &ham,
406 double *dham,
407 double *f,
408 double *df,
409 const double fluxJump,
410 const double *fluxJumpVector,
411 const double D_f)
412 {
413 // todo this doesn't look 1d/3d
414 // Prescribed flux jump across the interface, supplied by the physics file as
415 // [beta du/dn] = fluxJump(x) + fluxJumpVector(x) . n. The vector part carries
416 // the cases whose jump depends on the interface normal. Both default to zero,
417 // so a problem with no prescribed flux jump contributes nothing here.
418 double jump_flux = fluxJump;
419 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++)
420 jump_flux += fluxJumpVector[I] * immersedBoundary_normal[I];
421 r += jump_flux * D_f;
422 dr = 0.0;
423 ham = 0.0;
424 dham[0] = 0.0;
425 dham[1] = 0.0;
426 f[0] = 0.0;
427 f[1] = 0.0;
428 df[0] = 0.0;
429 df[1] = 0.0;
430 }

544 int eN_k_3d = eN_k * 3;

583 double r_s_a = 0.0, dr_s_a = 0.0, ham_s_a = 0.0;

617 mesh_grad_trial_ref.data(),
618 jac,

647 //PGIFEM

653 for (int i = 0; i < nDOF_trial_element; i++)
654 {
655 va[i] = gf_f.VA(i);
656 va_grad_trial[i * nSpace + 0] = gf_f.VA_x(i);
657 va_grad_trial[i * nSpace + 1] = gf_f.VA_y(i);
658 vb[i] = gf_f.VB(i);
659 vb_grad_trial[i * nSpace + 0] = gf_f.VB_x(i);
660 vb_grad_trial[i * nSpace + 1] = gf_f.VB_y(i);

667 ck.gradFromElementDOF(element_u.data(), vb_grad_trial, grad_ub);

674 uja += fluxLiftJ * gf_f.PSIA();

688 }

691 {

693 {
694 ua_grad_trial[j * nSpace + I] = va_grad_trial[j * nSpace + I];

705 ub_test_dV[i] = u_test_dV[i];

718 // just set from pre-evaluated quadrature point values for now

720 // On a demoted element the fluid is entirely one phase, but the pre-evaluated
721 // pointwise data still switches branch across the buried Gamma_f -- which lies inside
722 // the solid part of this element. H_s is only moment-exact against polynomials, and a
723 // coefficient that jumps mid-element is not one, so those quadrature points inject a
724 // contribution from a fluid that is not physically present. Substitute the surviving
725 // phase's constants, which makes the integrand polynomial again and H_s exact.
726 double a_dem[nSpace * nSpace];
727 double u_s_dem = embeddedBoundary_u_q.data()[eN_k];

729 {
730 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace * nSpace; I++) a_dem[I] = 0.0;
731 const double mu_dem = (demoted_f < 0) ? mua : mub;
732 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++) a_dem[I * nSpace + I] = mu_dem;
733 a = a_dem;
734 u_s_dem = (demoted_f < 0) ? embeddedBoundary_u_inner_q.data()[eN_k]
735 : embeddedBoundary_u_outer_q.data()[eN_k];
736 }
737 r = q_r.data()[eN_k];
738 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++)
739 {
740 f[I] = q_v.data()[eN_k * nSpace + I] * u;
741 df[I] = q_v.data()[eN_k * nSpace + I];
742 }
743 const double H_s = gf_s.H(0., 0.);
744 const double D_s = gf_s.D(0., 0.);
745 // Per-side Dirac for the solid surface. Weighting the single-cut D_s by a region fit
746 // (ImH_f * D_s) is the product-of-two-fits error again, and a large one -- about 31% on
747 // the segment length. Declared here because the Nitsche terms below consume it.
748 // Defaults to D_s, so elements cut by only one level set are untouched.
749 double D_s_a = D_s, D_s_b = D_s;
750 if (demoted_f != 0)
751 {
752 // The whole solid surface in this element borders the one surviving fluid region.
753 D_s_a = (demoted_f < 0) ? D_s : 0.0;
754 D_s_b = (demoted_f < 0) ? 0.0 : D_s;
755 }
756 else if (comp_DA != nullptr)
757 {
758 const double xr_d = x_ref.data()[k * 3 + 0], yr_d = x_ref.data()[k * 3 + 1];
759 D_s_a = equivalent_polynomials::composite::evaluate<nP_fit>(comp_DA, xr_d, yr_d);
760 D_s_b = equivalent_polynomials::composite::evaluate<nP_fit>(comp_DB, xr_d, yr_d);
761 }
762 if (embeddedBoundary)
763 {
764 double level_set_normal[nSpace];
765 double sign = 0.0;
766 double norm_exact = 0.0, norm_cut = 0.0;
767 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++)
768 {
769 sign += embeddedBoundary_normal_q.data()[eN_k_3d + I] * gf_s.get_normal()[I];
770 level_set_normal[I] = gf_s.get_normal()[I];
771 norm_cut += level_set_normal[I] * level_set_normal[I];
772 norm_exact += embeddedBoundary_normal_q.data()[eN_k_3d + I] * embeddedBoundary_normal_q.data()[eN_k_3d + I];
773 }
774 assert(std::fabs(1.0 - norm_cut) < 1.0e-8);
775 assert(std::fabs(1.0 - norm_exact) < 1.0e-8);
776 if (sign < 0.0)
777 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++)
778 level_set_normal[I] *= -1.0;
779 if (icase_f == 0)
780 {
781 // The solution here is ua on the mua side and ub on the mub side; the plain `u` is
782 // neither. Handing `u` to the penalty makes (u - u_s) nonzero even when the discrete
783 // solution is exactly right, and the O(100/h) penalty amplifies that.

785 if (embeddedBoundary_robin)

788 // but the jump-corrected VALUE still matters: u_infinity was derived

791 // Dirichlet data on Gamma_s, unrelated to the Robin target.
792 updateEmbeddedBoundaryRobinTerms(embeddedBoundary_robin_h_inner,
793 embeddedBoundary_robin_uInfinity_inner_q.data()[eN_k], ua + uja, r_s_a, dr_s_a, D_s_a);
794 updateEmbeddedBoundaryRobinTerms(embeddedBoundary_robin_h_outer,
795 embeddedBoundary_robin_uInfinity_outer_q.data()[eN_k], ub + ujb, r_s_b, dr_s_b, D_s_b);
796 }
797 else
798 {
799 double ga[nSpace], gb[nSpace];
800 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++)
801 {
802 ga[I] = grad_ua[I] + grad_uja[I];
803 gb[I] = grad_ub[I] + grad_ujb[I];
804 }
805 updateEmbeddedBoundaryTerms(embeddedBoundary_penalty / h_phi, dV, level_set_normal,
806 embeddedBoundary_u_inner_q.data()[eN_k], ua + uja, ga, mua,
807 r_s_a, dr_s_a, ham_s_a, dham_s_a, f_s_a, df_s_a, D_s_a);
808 updateEmbeddedBoundaryTerms(embeddedBoundary_penalty / h_phi, dV, level_set_normal,
809 embeddedBoundary_u_outer_q.data()[eN_k], ub + ujb, gb, mub,
810 r_s_b, dr_s_b, ham_s_b, dham_s_b, f_s_b, df_s_b, D_s_b);
811 }
812 }
813 else
814 {
815 // icase_f != 0: this element is wholly on one side of Gamma_f (icase_f < 0
816 // water/mua, icase_f > 0 air/mub -- the same sign convention as demoted_f
817 // and mu_dem above), so a single scalar h and a single per-phase target
818 // apply throughout -- NOT u_s_dem, which (like embeddedBoundary_u_inner_q
819 // above) carries the true Dirichlet solution, not the Robin target.
820 if (embeddedBoundary_robin)
821 {
822 const double h_here = (icase_f < 0) ? embeddedBoundary_robin_h_inner
823 : embeddedBoundary_robin_h_outer;
824 const double u_inf_here = (icase_f < 0)
825 ? embeddedBoundary_robin_uInfinity_inner_q.data()[eN_k]
826 : embeddedBoundary_robin_uInfinity_outer_q.data()[eN_k];
827 updateEmbeddedBoundaryRobinTerms(h_here, u_inf_here, u, r_s, dr_s, D_s);
828 }
829 else
830 {
831 updateEmbeddedBoundaryTerms(embeddedBoundary_penalty / h_phi, dV, level_set_normal,
832 u_s_dem, u, grad_u, a[0],
833 r_s, dr_s, ham_s, dham_s, f_s, df_s, D_s);
834 }
835 }
836 }
837 const double ImH_f = gf_f.ImH(0., 0.);
838 const double H_f = gf_f.H(0., 0.);

840 // come from the composite fit; otherwise they are the usual products, unchanged.
841 double wA = ImH_f * H_s, wB = H_f * H_s;
842 if (demoted_f != 0)
843 {
844 // Only one fluid region exists here; give it the whole fluid weight and the other none.
845 wA = (demoted_f < 0) ? H_s : 0.0;
846 wB = (demoted_f < 0) ? 0.0 : H_s;
847 }
848 else if (comp_A != nullptr)
849 {
850 const double xr = x_ref.data()[k * 3 + 0], yr = x_ref.data()[k * 3 + 1];
851 wA = equivalent_polynomials::composite::evaluate<nP_fit>(comp_A, xr, yr);
852 wB = equivalent_polynomials::composite::evaluate<nP_fit>(comp_B, xr, yr);
853 }
854 double D_f = gf_f.D(0., 0.);
855 if (comp_DFa != nullptr)
856 {
857 // Gamma_f's own Dirac measure, restricted to the part still inside the active
858 // fluid domain (see comp_DFa_cache's declaration) -- the plain, single-curve
859 // gf_f.D(0.,0.) above double-counts whatever part of Gamma_f's chord falls
860 // inside Gamma_s's masked-out solid on a triply-cut element.
861 const double xr_f = x_ref.data()[k * 3 + 0], yr_f = x_ref.data()[k * 3 + 1];
862 D_f = equivalent_polynomials::composite::evaluate<nP_fit>(comp_DFa, xr_f, yr_f);
863 }
864 // A demoted element's Gamma_f lies entirely inside the solid: no part of it borders
865 // fluid, so the flux-jump load must vanish exactly there (any fit would leave a
866 // spurious source).
867 if (demoted_f != 0)
868 D_f = 0.0;
869 if (H_s != 0.0 || D_s != 0.0 || D_f != 0.0) // for one embedded interface and one immersed interface
870 {
871 element_active = true;
872 elementIsActive[eN] = true;
873 }
874 if (immersedBoundary)
875 {
876 double level_set_normal[nSpace];
877 double sign = 0.0;
878 double norm_exact = 0.0, norm_cut = 0.0;
879 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++)
880 {
881 sign += immersedBoundary_normal_q.data()[eN_k_3d + I] * gf_f.get_normal()[I];
882 level_set_normal[I] = gf_f.get_normal()[I];
883 norm_cut += level_set_normal[I] * level_set_normal[I];
884 norm_exact += immersedBoundary_normal_q.data()[eN_k_3d + I] * immersedBoundary_normal_q.data()[eN_k_3d + I];
885 }
886 assert(std::fabs(1.0 - norm_cut) < 1.0e-8);
887 assert(std::fabs(1.0 - norm_exact) < 1.0e-8);
888 if (sign < 0.0)
889 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++)
890 level_set_normal[I] *= -1.0;
891 updateImmersedBoundaryTerms(immersedBoundary_penalty / h_phi, // penalty,
892 dV,
893 level_set_normal,
894 x,
895 y,
896 z,
897 immersedBoundary_u_q.data()[eN_k],
898 u,
899 grad_u,
900 a[0], // assume scalar diffusion for now
901 r_f,
902 dr_f,
903 ham_f,
904 dham_f,
905 f_f,
906 df_f,
907 immersedBoundary_fluxJump_q.data()[eN_k],
908 &immersedBoundary_fluxJumpVector_q.data()[eN_k_3d],
909 // Gamma_f's jump physics only applies in the fluid: on an element that
910 // sits (locally, at this quadrature point) entirely inside the embedded
911 // solid, H_s==0 and D_f alone (gf_f.D, or the raw single-curve fallback
912 // when comp_DFa isn't available) does not know that -- it only encodes
913 // where Gamma_f itself is, not whether the fluid actually exists there.
914 // Without this factor an element wholly inside the solid but crossed by
915 // Gamma_f gets a fixed, u-independent Dirac source with nothing in the
916 // Jacobian to balance it (the bulk terms are already correctly zero via
917 // wA=wB=0), so Newton can never drive that row's residual to zero.
918 // On a triply-cut cell comp_DFa is already restricted to the fluid part of
919 // Gamma_f; multiplying it by the H_s fit again would restrict twice (a
920 // product of two fits), so H_s is applied only to the single-curve D_f.
921 (comp_DFa != nullptr) ? D_f : D_f * H_s);
922 }

924 // moving mesh
925 //

927 /* mesh_velocity[0] = xt; */
928 /* mesh_velocity[1] = yt; */

947 // calculate strong residual
948 pdeResidual_u = ck.Advection_strong(df, grad_u) + ck.Reaction_strong(r); // ck.Mass_strong(m_t) + ck.Advection_strong(df,grad_u) + ck.Reaction_strong(r);
949 // calculate adjoint
950 for (int i = 0; i < nDOF_test_element; i++)
951 {
952 // int eN_k_i_nSpace = (eN_k*nDOF_trial_element+i)*nSpace;
953 // Lstar_u[i] = ck.Advection_adjoint(df,&u_grad_test_dV.data()[eN_k_i_nSpace]);
954 int i_nSpace = i * nSpace;
955 Lstar_u[i] = ck.Advection_adjoint(df, &u_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]);
956 }
957 // calculate tau and tau*Res
958 calculateSubgridError_tau(elementDiameter.data()[eN], dm_t, df, cfl.data()[eN_k], tau0);
959 calculateSubgridError_tau(Ct_sge,
960 G,
961 dm_t,
962 df,
963 tau1,
964 cfl.data()[eN_k]);
965
966 tau = useMetrics * tau1 + (1.0 - useMetrics) * tau0;
967
968 subgridError_u = -tau * pdeResidual_u;
969 //
970 // calculate shock capturing diffusion
971 //
972 ck.calculateNumericalDiffusion(shockCapturingDiffusion, elementDiameter.data()[eN], pdeResidual_u, grad_u, numDiff0);
973 ck.calculateNumericalDiffusion(shockCapturingDiffusion, sc_uref, sc_alpha, G, G_dd_G, pdeResidual_u, grad_u, numDiff1);
974 q_numDiff_u.data()[eN_k] = useMetrics * numDiff1 + (1.0 - useMetrics) * numDiff0;
975 //
976 // update element residual
977 //
978 // Leveque & Li 1994, Examples 1, 3, 4, PWC, PWL, PWQ, PWcubic
979 double a_loc[nSpace * nSpace];
980 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace * nSpace; I++) a_loc[I] = 0.0;
981
982 for (int i = 0; i < nDOF_test_element; i++)
983 {
984 int i_nSpace = i * nSpace;
985 if (icase_f == 0)
986 {
987 if(!gf_f.exact.edge && !gf_f.exact.corner)//full cut or cut on boundary of negative cell
988 {
989 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++) a_loc[I * nSpace + I] = mua;
990 elementResidual_u.data()[i] += wA * (ck.Advection_weak(f, &ua_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]) +
991 ck.Diffusion_weak(sd_rowptr.data(), sd_colind.data(), a_loc, grad_ua, &ua_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]) +
992 ck.Diffusion_weak(sd_rowptr.data(), sd_colind.data(), a_loc, grad_uja, &ua_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]) +
993 ck.Reaction_weak(r, ua_test_dV[i]) +
994 ck.NumericalDiffusion(q_numDiff_u_last.data()[eN_k], grad_ua, &ua_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]));
995
996 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++) a_loc[I * nSpace + I] = mub;
997 elementResidual_u.data()[i] += wB * (ck.Advection_weak(f, &ub_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]) +
998 ck.Diffusion_weak(sd_rowptr.data(), sd_colind.data(), a_loc, grad_ub, &ub_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]) +
999 ck.Diffusion_weak(sd_rowptr.data(), sd_colind.data(), a_loc, grad_ujb, &ub_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]) +
1000 ck.Reaction_weak(r, ub_test_dV[i]) +
1001 ck.NumericalDiffusion(q_numDiff_u_last.data()[eN_k], grad_ub, &ub_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]));
1002 // Flux-jump load int_Gamma_f J_f v: D_f times the IFE test function, NOT weighted by
1003 // wA/wB. On Gamma_f va = vb = v, and D_f integrates va and vb (polynomials of degree
1004 // <= nP_fit) exactly; weighting by the Heaviside fits would multiply two fits and
1005 // move part of the load between branch-a and branch-b nodes.
1006 elementResidual_u.data()[i] += r_f * 0.5 * (ua_test_dV[i] + ub_test_dV[i]);
1007 }
1008 else if (gf_f.exact.edge == -1 || gf_f.exact.corner == -1)
1009 {
1010 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++) a_loc[I * nSpace + I] = mua;
1011 elementResidual_u.data()[i] += wA * (ck.Advection_weak(f, &ua_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]) +
1012 ck.Diffusion_weak(sd_rowptr.data(), sd_colind.data(), a_loc, grad_ua, &ua_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]) +
1013 ck.Diffusion_weak(sd_rowptr.data(), sd_colind.data(), a_loc, grad_uja, &ua_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]) +
1014 ck.Reaction_weak(r, ua_test_dV[i]) +
1015 ck.NumericalDiffusion(q_numDiff_u_last.data()[eN_k], grad_ua, &ua_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]));
1016 elementResidual_u.data()[i] += r_f * ua_test_dV[i];
1017 }
1018 else if (gf_f.exact.edge == 1 || gf_f.exact.corner == 1)
1019 {
1020 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++) a_loc[I * nSpace + I] = mub;
1021 elementResidual_u.data()[i] += wB * (ck.Advection_weak(f, &ub_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]) +
1022 ck.Diffusion_weak(sd_rowptr.data(), sd_colind.data(), a_loc, grad_ub, &ub_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]) +
1023 ck.Diffusion_weak(sd_rowptr.data(), sd_colind.data(), a_loc, grad_ujb, &ub_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]) +
1024 ck.Reaction_weak(r, ub_test_dV[i]) +
1025 ck.NumericalDiffusion(q_numDiff_u_last.data()[eN_k], grad_ub, &ub_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]));
1026 elementResidual_u.data()[i] += r_f * ub_test_dV[i];
1027 }
1028 else assert(false && "Invalid gf_f.exact.edge/corner values. Should be -1, 0 or +1.");
1029 }
1030 else
1031 {
1032
1033 elementResidual_u.data()[i] += H_s * (ck.Advection_weak(f, &u_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]) +
1034 ck.Diffusion_weak(sd_rowptr.data(), sd_colind.data(), a, grad_u, &u_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]) +
1035 ck.Reaction_weak(r, u_test_dV[i]) +
1036 ck.SubgridError(subgridError_u, Lstar_u[i]) +
1037 ck.NumericalDiffusion(q_numDiff_u_last.data()[eN_k], grad_u, &u_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]));
1038 }
1039 if (embeddedBoundary)
1040 {
1041 if (gf_s.exact.edge >= 0 && !gf_s.exact.corner)
1042 {
1043 if (icase_f == 0)
1044 {
1045 // Test against the reconstructed basis the bulk uses, split by which
1046 // fluid region each part of the solid surface sits in. ImH_f + H_f = 1,
1047 // so the total contribution is preserved.
1048 // Each side already carries its own piece of the solid surface via
1049 // D_s_a / D_s_b, so no ImH_f / H_f weighting here.
1050 elementResidual_u.data()[i] +=
1051 (ck.Advection_weak(f_s_a, &ua_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]) +
1052 ck.Reaction_weak(r_s_a, ua_test_dV[i]) +
1053 ck.Hamiltonian_weak(ham_s_a, ua_test_dV[i])) +
1054 (ck.Advection_weak(f_s_b, &ub_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]) +
1055 ck.Reaction_weak(r_s_b, ub_test_dV[i]) +
1056 ck.Hamiltonian_weak(ham_s_b, ub_test_dV[i]));
1057 }
1058 else
1059 {
1060 elementResidual_u.data()[i] += (ck.Advection_weak(f_s, &u_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]) +
1061 ck.Reaction_weak(r_s, u_test_dV[i]) +
1062 ck.Hamiltonian_weak(ham_s, u_test_dV[i]));
1063 }
1064 }
1065 }
1066 // immersedBoundary's r_f (the flux-jump Dirac reaction) is tested above against the
1067 // IFEM test function on Gamma_f (0.5*(va+vb), = va = vb there), not against the plain,
1068 // unenriched u_test_dV (va != vb != u_test away from the vertices) and not inside the
1069 // wA/wB-weighted branch terms (a product of two fits that moves load between branches). f_f/ham_f/df_f/dham_f are always zero (see
1070 // updateImmersedBoundaryTerms), so nothing else from that call belongs here.
1071 }
1072 // Error is only meaningful where the PDE is actually assembled -- strictly, in the
1073 // active fluid domain phi_s >= 0. The old gate used H_s (the moment-fit area
1074 // weight), which is only guaranteed correct in an *integrated* sense: pointwise it
1075 // can overshoot [0,1] or go negative near a cut (confirmed directly: values like
1076 // H_s=1.14 and H_s=-0.066 were measured on a real triply-cut element), so "H_s>0"
1077 // let some genuinely-inside-the-solid quadrature points compete for the L^infty
1078 // max, and weighting L2 by H_s (rather than gating it) let their squared error
1079 // contribute in proportion to an overshot/undershot weight instead of either the
1080 // full contribution or none. Gate by the raw, pointwise level-set value instead --
1081 // exact, not a moment-fit approximation -- so no solid-side point (node or
1082 // quadrature point alike) ever enters either norm, regardless of how H_s's fit
1083 // behaves right at that point.
1084 const double phi_s_q = embeddedBoundary_sdf_q.data()[eN_k];
1085 double L2_contrib = 0.0;
1086 // H1 seminorm part: |grad(u - u_h)|^2 of the phase the point belongs to, with the same
1087 // weights and the same fluid gate as the L2 error.
1088 double H1_contrib = 0.0;
1089 const double *gex_in = &q_grad_u_exact_inner.data()[eN_k * nSpace];
1090 const double *gex_out = &q_grad_u_exact_outer.data()[eN_k * nSpace];
1091 if (icase_f == 0)
1092 {
1093 double sol_in = q_u_exact_inner.data()[eN_k];
1094 double err_in = fabs(ua + uja - sol_in);
1095 L2_contrib += ImH_f * err_in * err_in * dV;
1096 double sol_out = q_u_exact_outer.data()[eN_k];
1097 double err_out = fabs(ub + ujb - sol_out);
1098 L2_contrib += H_f * err_out * err_out * dV;
1099 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++)
1100 {
1101 const double gerr_in = grad_ua[I] + grad_uja[I] - gex_in[I];
1102 const double gerr_out = grad_ub[I] + grad_ujb[I] - gex_out[I];
1103 H1_contrib += (ImH_f * gerr_in * gerr_in + H_f * gerr_out * gerr_out) * dV;
1104 }
1105 if (phi_s_q >= 0.0)
1106 {
1107 if (ImH_f >= H_f)
1108 Linfty_error = std::max(Linfty_error, err_in);
1109 else
1110 Linfty_error = std::max(Linfty_error, err_out);
1111 }
1112 }
1113 else
1114 {
1115 if (icase_f == -1)
1116 {
1117 double sol = q_u_exact_inner.data()[eN_k];
1118 double err = fabs(u - sol);
1119 L2_contrib += err * err * dV;
1120 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++)
1121 H1_contrib += (grad_u[I] - gex_in[I]) * (grad_u[I] - gex_in[I]) * dV;
1122 if (phi_s_q >= 0.0)
1123 {
1124 Linfty_error = std::max(Linfty_error, err);
1125 }
1126 }
1127 if (icase_f == 1)
1128 {
1129 double sol = q_u_exact_outer.data()[eN_k];
1130 double err = fabs(u - sol);
1131 L2_contrib += err * err * dV;
1132 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++)
1133 H1_contrib += (grad_u[I] - gex_out[I]) * (grad_u[I] - gex_out[I]) * dV;
1134 if (phi_s_q >= 0.0)
1135 {
1136 Linfty_error = std::max(Linfty_error, err);
1137 }
1138 }
1139 }
1140 if (phi_s_q >= 0.0)
1141 {
1142 L2_error += L2_contrib;
1143 H1_error += H1_contrib;
1144 }
1145 }
1146 }
1147

1247 xt::pyarray<double> &q_grad_u_exact_inner = args.array<double>("q_grad_u_exact_inner");
1248 xt::pyarray<double> &q_grad_u_exact_outer = args.array<double>("q_grad_u_exact_outer");
1249 xt::pyarray<double> &H1_error = args.array<double>("H1_error");
1250 const bool recomputeIFEMGeometry = args.scalar<int>("recomputeIFEMGeometry");
1251 const bool fluxJumpLift = args.scalar<int>("immersedBoundary_fluxJumpLift");
1252 ensureIFEMCacheSized(nElements_global); // also (re)asserts useExact = true on (re)allocation
1253 if (recomputeIFEMGeometry)
1254 ifemGeometryGeneration++;
1255 for (int eN = 0; eN < nElements_global; eN++)
1256 fluxLiftAmp[eN] = immersedBoundary_fluxJump_element.data()[eN];
1257 ifem_boundaries.clear();
1258 ifem_boundary_elements.clear();
1259 cutfem_boundaries.clear();
1260 cutfem_boundary_elements.clear();
1261 elementIsActive.resize(nElements_global);
1262 // Coefficients.triplyCut_edgeFluidSide: take the fluid-side one-sided edge correction on
1263 // triply-cut cells (flips the sign of the correction in residual and Jacobian).
1264 const bool tcFluidMode = args.scalar<int>("triplyCut_edgeFluidSide");
1265 // Coefficients.triplyCut_edgeBoundaryOnly (use with SCIFEM on): keep the one-sided fluid-side
1266 // correction only on root-adjacent edges that lie on the exterior boundary. Interior ones are then
1267 // handled by SCIFEM's two-sided consistency term, which has no counterpart on an exterior edge.
1268 const bool tcBoundaryOnly = args.scalar<int>("triplyCut_edgeBoundaryOnly");
1269 const double tcSgn = tcFluidMode ? -1.0 : 1.0;
1270
1271 //
1272 // loop over elements to compute volume integrals and load them into element and global residual
1273 //
1274 // eN is the element index
1275 // eN_k is the quadrature point index for a scalar
1276 // eN_k_nSpace is the quadrature point index for a vector
1277 // eN_i is the element test function index
1278 // eN_j is the element trial function index
1279 // eN_k_j is the quadrature point index for a trial function
1280 // eN_k_i is the quadrature point index for a trial function
1281 // Per-face reference-ELEMENT quadrature points, taken from proteus' own trace tables.
1282 // Simplex::calculate(..., isBoundary=true) reads its xi_r argument as reference *element*
1283 // coordinates (it forms x = node0 + Jac_0*xi_r), but xB_ref holds reference *boundary*
1284 // points (t,0,0) -- passing those directly puts every face's points on the local
1285 // node0->node1 edge, i.e. correct only for local face 2. mesh_trial_trace_ref holds the P1
1286 // mesh shape functions at (face, quadrature point) and for a triangle those barycentric
1287 // functions ARE the reference coordinates (phi_0=1-xi-eta, phi_1=xi, phi_2=eta), so this
1288 // is exactly consistent with calculateMapping_elementBoundary's own convention.
1289 double xB_ref_faces[nDOF_mesh_trial_element * nQuadraturePoints_elementBoundary * 3];
1290 for (int f = 0; f < nDOF_mesh_trial_element; f++)
1291 for (int kb = 0; kb < nQuadraturePoints_elementBoundary; kb++)
1292 {
1293 const int fkb = f * nQuadraturePoints_elementBoundary + kb;
1294 const double *phi_m = &mesh_trial_trace_ref.data()[fkb * nDOF_mesh_trial_element];
1295 xB_ref_faces[fkb * 3 + 0] = phi_m[1];
1296 xB_ref_faces[fkb * 3 + 1] = phi_m[2];
1297 xB_ref_faces[fkb * 3 + 2] = 0.0;
1298 }
1299 for (int eN = 0; eN < nElements_global; eN++)
1300 {
1301 // declare local storage for element residual and initialize
1302 // double elementResidual_u[nDOF_test_element],element_u[nDOF_trial_element];
1303 auto elementResidual_u = xt::pyarray<double>::from_shape({nDOF_test_element});
1304 auto element_u = xt::pyarray<double>::from_shape({nDOF_trial_element});
1305 bool element_active = false;
1306 elementIsActive[eN] = false;
1307 for (int i = 0; i < nDOF_trial_element; i++)
1308 {
1309 int eN_i = eN * nDOF_trial_element + i;
1310 element_u.data()[i] = u_dof.data()[u_l2g.data()[eN_i]];
1311 } // i
1312 double element_phi_s[nDOF_trial_element];
1313 for (int j = 0; j < nDOF_trial_element; j++)
1314 {
1315 int eN_j = eN * nDOF_trial_element + j;
1316 element_phi_s[j] = embeddedBoundary_sdf_nodes.data()[u_l2g.data()[eN_j]];
1317 }
1318 double element_phi_f[nDOF_trial_element];
1319 for (int j = 0; j < nDOF_trial_element; j++)
1320 {
1321 int eN_j = eN * nDOF_trial_element + j;
1322 element_phi_f[j] = immersedBoundary_sdf_nodes.data()[u_l2g.data()[eN_j]];
1323 }
1324 double element_nodes[nDOF_trial_element * 3];
1325 for (int i = 0; i < nDOF_trial_element; i++)
1326 {
1327 int eN_i = eN * nDOF_trial_element + i;
1328 for (int I = 0; I < 3; I++)
1329 element_nodes[i * 3 + I] = mesh_dof.data()[u_l2g.data()[eN_i] * 3 + I];
1330 } // i
1331 if (gf_s_interior_gen[eN] != ifemGeometryGeneration)
1332 {
1333 gf_s_interior_icase[eN] = gf_s_cache[eN].calculate(element_phi_s, element_nodes, x_ref.data(), false);
1334 gf_s_interior_gen[eN] = ifemGeometryGeneration;
1335 }
1336 int icase_s = gf_s_interior_icase[eN];
1337 if (icase_s == 0)
1338 {
1339 // only works for simplices
1340 for (int ebN_element = 0; ebN_element < nDOF_mesh_trial_element; ebN_element++)
1341 {
1342 const int ebN = elementBoundariesArray.data()[eN * nDOF_mesh_trial_element + ebN_element];
1343 // Every interior face of a Gamma_s-cut element, owned or not. The residual is assembled
1344 // with full overlap (each rank sums all of its local elements into the rows it owns
1345 // and drops the rest), so a face term has to be summed on every rank that has both
1346 // of its elements; skipping the faces another rank owns lost their contribution to
1347 // this rank's owned rows (2 ranks: 7 wrong rows, solution off by up to 3e-3).
1348 if (elementBoundaryElementsArray.data()[ebN * 2 + 1] != -1)
1349 cutfem_boundaries.insert(ebN);
1350 }
1351 }
1352 if (gf_f_interior_gen[eN] != ifemGeometryGeneration)
1353 {
1354 gf_f_interior_icase[eN] = gf_f_cache[eN].calculate(element_phi_f, element_nodes, x_ref.data(), mua, mub, jf, false, false);
1355 gf_f_interior_gen[eN] = ifemGeometryGeneration;
1356 }
1357 int icase_f = gf_f_interior_icase[eN];
1358 // Records that the buried-Gamma_f logic below demoted this element, and to which
1359 // phase: -1 = fluid is all Omega^- (mua), +1 = all Omega^+ (mub), 0 = not demoted.
1360 int demoted_f = 0;
1361 // Both level sets genuinely cut this element: the product weight ImH_f*H_s is not
1362 // moment-exact here, so fit one polynomial per intersected region instead. Any
1363 // element cut by at most one level set is left entirely alone.
1364 comp_valid[eN] = 0;
1365 comp_DF_valid[eN] = 0;
1366 if (icase_s == 0 && icase_f == 0 && nSpace == 2)
1367 {
1368 const double phi_s3[3] = {element_phi_s[0], element_phi_s[1], element_phi_s[2]};
1369 const double phi_f3[3] = {element_phi_f[0], element_phi_f[1], element_phi_f[2]};
1370 // The fluid interface can cross this element and still lie entirely inside the
1371 // solid, leaving the fluid undivided. There is then no fluid-fluid interface to
1372 // resolve *in the fluid*, so the two-sided IFEM reconstruction has nothing to
1373 // do -- and building it anyway means enforcing interface conditions along a
1374 // segment where no fluid exists. Demote the element to ordinary two-phase by
1375 // reporting the fluid's own side, which routes every downstream branch (bulk
1376 // terms, the solid's Nitsche condition, the error norm) to the standard basis.
1377 double areaA = 0.0, areaB = 0.0;
1378 equivalent_polynomials::composite::fluid_region_areas(phi_s3, phi_f3, areaA, areaB);
1379 // NOTE: we deliberately do NOT change icase_f here. Switching this element to the
1380 // standard basis would make it disagree with its neighbours about what their shared
1381 // DOFs mean: the neighbour (genuinely cut in the fluid) needs the pointwise nodal
1382 // value of u, while this element would need the surviving branch continued to all of
1383 // its nodes -- including nodes on the other side of Gamma_f. One DOF cannot be both,
1384 // so the exact solution would drop out of the discrete space entirely. Keeping the
1385 // IFEM basis costs nothing (u_ex satisfies the interface conditions globally, so
1386 // imposing them along a buried stretch of Gamma_f is harmless) and keeps the space
1387 // conforming. What we DO fix is the weights: the empty region must get exactly zero
1388 // rather than whatever a fit over an empty region would produce.
1389 //
1390 // Tolerance, not exact equality: a genuine tangency between Gamma_f and Gamma_s
1391 // (their zero-sets crossing exactly on a shared mesh edge) makes one region's true
1392 // area a single point, but floating-point roundoff in the clip almost never lands
1393 // on bit-exact 0.0 -- it lands a few ULPs away (observed: ~1e-33 against a
1394 // reference-triangle scale of 0.5). An exact-equality check misses that case
1395 // entirely and falls through to fitting a degree-4 polynomial to a numerically
1396 // degenerate sliver, which is unstable (observed: off by 64x on its own area).
1397 // areaTol is far above that roundoff floor and far below any physically meaningful
1398 // sub-area, so it can't misclassify a genuinely small-but-real fluid region.
1399 const double areaTol = 1.0e-9;
1400 if (areaB <= areaTol && areaA > areaTol)
1401 demoted_f = -1; // fluid is all Omega^- (mua side)
1402 else if (areaA <= areaTol && areaB > areaTol)
1403 demoted_f = 1; // fluid is all Omega^+ (mub side)
1404 else
1405 {
1406 const double nodes2[6] = {element_nodes[0], element_nodes[1],
1407 element_nodes[3], element_nodes[4],
1408 element_nodes[6], element_nodes[7]};
1409 comp_valid[eN] = (equivalent_polynomials::composite::weights<nP_fit>(
1410 phi_s3, phi_f3,
1411 &comp_A_cache[(std::size_t)eN * nCompMon],
1412 &comp_B_cache[(std::size_t)eN * nCompMon]) &&
1413 equivalent_polynomials::composite::dirac_weights<nP_fit>(
1414 phi_s3, phi_f3, nodes2,
1415 &comp_DA_cache[(std::size_t)eN * nCompMon],
1416 &comp_DB_cache[(std::size_t)eN * nCompMon])) ? 1 : 0;
1417 // Gamma_f's own Dirac measure, split by Gamma_s's sign (see comp_DFm_cache's
1418 // declaration): comp_DFa is the part of Gamma_f's chord still inside the
1419 // active fluid, the only part any Gamma_f Dirac-delta term (e.g. the
1420 // prescribed flux jump) should ever see on this element.
1421 comp_DF_valid[eN] = equivalent_polynomials::composite::edge_weights<nP_fit>(
1422 phi_f3, phi_s3, nodes2,
1423 &comp_DFm_cache[(std::size_t)eN * nCompMon],
1424 &comp_DFa_cache[(std::size_t)eN * nCompMon]) ? 1 : 0;

1428 double JB[nDOF_trial_element];

1441 // indexing convention for P1: edge opposite to node i is given by (i+1)%3 and (i+2)%3 nodes.
1442 // nathawani: P2 needs different indexing convention.
1443 // Do we need corner cases? (<=0) or just (<0) for cut edge detection?
1444 // The SCIFEM facet term is an inter-element consistency term: it needs the
1445 // trace from BOTH elements sharing the face. On an exterior face the second
1446 // entry of elementBoundaryElementsArray is -1, and the loops below index
1447 // elementIsActive[] and gf_f_cache[] with it before any validity test, which
1448 // is out of bounds. test=8's circle lies wholly inside the domain so this

1459 // The jump function is, in general, not constant over the cut element, so it
1460 // must be evaluated at each node's own coordinates (not once at the cut
1461 // barycenter) -- otherwise JA/JB are constant over the element and their
1462 // interpolated gradients (grad_uja, grad_ujb) vanish identically.
1463 const double eps_phi = 1.0e-12;
1464 auto assign_jump_side = [&](int i, bool isOuter, double jump) {
1465 if (isOuter)
1466 {
1467 JA[i] = -jump;
1468 JB[i] = 0.0;
1469 }
1470 else
1471 {
1472 JA[i] = 0.0;
1473 JB[i] = jump;
1474 }
1475 };
1476 for (int i = 0; i < nDOF_trial_element; i++)
1477 {
1478
1479 int eN_i = eN * nDOF_trial_element + i;
1480 const double jump_i = immersedBoundary_solutionJump_nodes.data()[u_l2g.data()[eN_i]];
1481 if (element_phi_f[i] > 0.0)
1482 {
1483 assign_jump_side(i, true, jump_i);
1484 }
1485 else if (element_phi_f[i] <= 0.0)

1487 assign_jump_side(i, false, jump_i);

1489 }

1492 // j_h carries the flux jump [mu dj_h/dn] = sum_i (mub JB_i grad phi_i^b - mua JA_i grad phi_i^a).n,
1493 // which vanishes when J_s is the same at every node of the cell (partition of unity) but

1500 bool liftCell = false;
1501 {
1502 int nneg = 0, npos = 0, nzero = 0;
1503 for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
1504 {
1505 if (element_phi_f[i] < 0.0) nneg++;
1506 else if (element_phi_f[i] > 0.0) npos++;
1507 else nzero++;

1516 if (immersedBoundary_solutionJump_nodes.data()[u_l2g.data()[eN * nDOF_trial_element + i]] != jump0)

1521 const double ex1 = element_nodes[6] - element_nodes[0], ey1 = element_nodes[7] - element_nodes[1];
1522 const double dp0 = element_phi_f[1] - element_phi_f[0], dp1 = element_phi_f[2] - element_phi_f[0];
1523 const double det = ex0 * ey1 - ex1 * ey0;
1524 double nf[2] = {(dp0 * ey1 - dp1 * ey0) / det, (ex0 * dp1 - ex1 * dp0) / det};

1527 nf[1] /= nnorm;

1529 auto jhFluxJump = [&](int k) {
1530 gfj.set_quad(k);
1531 double s = 0.0;
1532 for (int i = 0; i < nDOF_trial_element; i++)
1533 s += mub * JB[i] * (gfj.VB_x(i) * nf[0] + gfj.VB_y(i) * nf[1]) -
1534 mua * JA[i] * (gfj.VA_x(i) * nf[0] + gfj.VA_y(i) * nf[1]);
1535 return s;
1536 };

1545 {
1546 const double Fk = jhFluxJump(k);
1547 const double wk = gfj.D(0., 0.) * dV_ref.data()[k];
1548 wsum += wk;
1549 fsum += wk * Fk;
1550 usum += Fk;
1551 }
1552 Fj = (std::fabs(wsum) > 1.0e-14) ? fsum / wsum : usum / nQuadraturePoints_element;

1555 }

1801 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++)
1802 d += std::fabs(gp_xq[1][j][I] - gp_xq[0][k][I]);
1803 if (d < bestd) { bestd = d; best = j; }
1804 }
1805 gp_kmap[k] = best;
1806 }
1807 }
1808 for (int kb = 0; kb < nQuadraturePoints_elementBoundary; kb++)
1809 {
1810 double Du_Dn_jump = 0.0, dS;
1811 double Du_Dn_jump_a = 0.0, Du_Dn_jump_b = 0.0;
1812 bool phaseA_ok = true, phaseB_ok = true;
1813 for (int eN_side = 0; eN_side < 2; eN_side++)
1814 {
1815 int ebN = *it,
1816 eN = elementBoundaryElementsArray.data()[ebN * 2 + eN_side];
1817 for (int i = 0; i < nDOF_test_element; i++)
1818 {
1819 Dw_Dn_jump[u_l2g.data()[eN * nDOF_test_element + i]] = 0.0;
1820 Dw_Dn_jump_a[u_l2g.data()[eN * nDOF_test_element + i]] = 0.0;
1821 Dw_Dn_jump_b[u_l2g.data()[eN * nDOF_test_element + i]] = 0.0;
1822 }
1823 }
1824 for (int eN_side = 0; eN_side < 2; eN_side++)
1825 {
1826 int ebN = *it,
1827 eN = elementBoundaryElementsArray.data()[ebN * 2 + eN_side],
1828 ebN_local = elementBoundaryLocalElementBoundariesArray.data()[ebN * 2 + eN_side],
1829 eN_nDOF_trial_element = eN * nDOF_trial_element,
1830 kb_s = (eN_side == 0) ? kb : gp_kmap[kb],
1831 ebN_local_kb = ebN_local * nQuadraturePoints_elementBoundary + kb_s,
1832 ebN_local_kb_nSpace = ebN_local_kb * nSpace;
1833 double u_int = 0.0,
1834 grad_u_int[nSpace] = {0., 0.},
1835 jac_int[nSpace * nSpace],
1836 jacDet_int,
1837 jacInv_int[nSpace * nSpace],
1838 boundaryJac[nSpace * (nSpace - 1)],
1839 metricTensor[(nSpace - 1) * (nSpace - 1)],
1840 metricTensorDetSqrt,
1841 u_test_dS[nDOF_test_element],
1842 u_grad_trial_trace[nDOF_trial_element * nSpace],
1843 u_grad_test_dS[nDOF_trial_element * nSpace],
1844 normal[2], x_int, y_int, z_int, xt_int, yt_int, zt_int, integralScaling,
1845 G[nSpace * nSpace], G_dd_G, tr_G, h_phi, h_penalty, penalty,
1846 force_x, force_y, force_z, force_p_x, force_p_y, force_p_z, force_v_x, force_v_y, force_v_z, r_x, r_y, r_z;
1847 // compute information about mapping from reference element to physical element
1848 ck.calculateMapping_elementBoundary(eN,
1849 ebN_local,
1850 kb_s,
1851 ebN_local_kb,
1852 mesh_dof.data(),
1853 mesh_l2g.data(),
1854 mesh_trial_trace_ref.data(),
1855 mesh_grad_trial_trace_ref.data(),
1856 boundaryJac_ref.data(),
1857 jac_int,
1858 jacDet_int,
1859 jacInv_int,
1860 boundaryJac,
1861 metricTensor,
1862 metricTensorDetSqrt,
1863 normal_ref.data(),
1864 normal,
1865 x_int, y_int, z_int);
1866 dS = metricTensorDetSqrt * dS_ref.data()[kb_s]; // kb_s mirrors kb: same Gauss weight
1867 // compute shape and solution information
1868 // shape
1869 ck.gradTrialFromRef(&u_grad_trial_trace_ref.data()[ebN_local_kb_nSpace * nDOF_trial_element], jacInv_int, u_grad_trial_trace);
1870 // solution and gradients
1871 ck.valFromDOF(u_dof.data(), &u_l2g.data()[eN_nDOF_trial_element], &u_trial_trace_ref.data()[ebN_local_kb * nDOF_test_element], u_int);
1872 ck.gradFromDOF(u_dof.data(), &u_l2g.data()[eN_nDOF_trial_element], u_grad_trial_trace, grad_u_int);
1873 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++)
1874 {
1875 Du_Dn_jump += grad_u_int[I] * normal[I];
1876 }
1877 for (int i = 0; i < nDOF_test_element; i++)
1878 {
1879 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++)
1880 Dw_Dn_jump[u_l2g.data()[eN_nDOF_trial_element + i]] += u_grad_trial_trace[i * nSpace + I] * normal[I];
1881 }
1882 // --- Ghost penalty, per fluid phase. The penalty is meant to kill *spurious*
1883 // normal-derivative jumps across a cut element's face. On an element that the
1884 // fluid interface also cuts, the combined IFEM solution genuinely kinks at
1885 // Gamma_f, so penalising the combined gradient penalises physics and destroys
1886 // exactness. Each phase's own polynomial extension IS smooth across the face,
1887 // so we penalise [[d(u_a)/dn]] and [[d(u_b)/dn]] separately -- the same per-side
1888 // treatment the bulk (wA/wB) and Nitsche (D_s_a/D_s_b) terms already get.
1889 int gp_icase = -2; // -2: no fluid interface in play, single phase
1890 double gp_va_grad[nDOF_trial_element * nSpace], gp_vb_grad[nDOF_trial_element * nSpace];
1891 // Jump-lift arrays (assign_jump_side's own node pattern, ~line 1499-1524) for
1892 // THIS element eN, needed below to add grad_uja/grad_ujb to the ghost penalty's
1893 // per-phase normal derivative. Zero unless eN is genuinely Gamma_f-cut.
1894 double gp_JA[nDOF_trial_element], gp_JB[nDOF_trial_element];
1895 std::fill(gp_JA, gp_JA + nDOF_trial_element, 0.0);
1896 std::fill(gp_JB, gp_JB + nDOF_trial_element, 0.0);
1897 if (immersedBoundary)
1898 {
1899 double gp_phi_f[nDOF_trial_element], gp_nodes[nDOF_trial_element * 3];
1900 for (int i = 0; i < nDOF_trial_element; i++)
1901 {
1902 const int gp_eN_i = eN * nDOF_trial_element + i;
1903 gp_phi_f[i] = immersedBoundary_sdf_nodes.data()[u_l2g.data()[gp_eN_i]];
1904 for (int I = 0; I < 3; I++)
1905 gp_nodes[i * 3 + I] = mesh_dof.data()[u_l2g.data()[gp_eN_i] * 3 + I];
1906 }
1907 if (gf_f_boundary_gen[eN] != ifemGeometryGeneration)
1908 {
1909 gf_f_boundary_icase[eN] = gf_f_cache[eN].calculate(gp_phi_f, gp_nodes, xB_ref_faces, mua, mub, jf, true, false);
1910 gf_f_boundary_gen[eN] = ifemGeometryGeneration;
1911 }
1912 gp_icase = gf_f_boundary_icase[eN];
1913 if (gp_icase == 0)
1914 {
1915 for (int i = 0; i < nDOF_trial_element; i++)
1916 {
1917 const double jump_i = immersedBoundary_solutionJump_nodes.data()[u_l2g.data()[eN * nDOF_trial_element + i]];
1918 if (gp_phi_f[i] > 0.0)
1919 gp_JA[i] = -jump_i;
1920 else
1921 gp_JB[i] = jump_i;
1922 }
1923 }
1924 }
1925 if (gp_icase == 0)
1926 {
1927 gf_f_cache[eN].set_boundary_quad(ebN_local_kb);
1928 for (int i = 0; i < nDOF_trial_element; i++)
1929 {
1930 gp_va_grad[i * nSpace + 0] = gf_f_cache[eN].VA_x(i);
1931 gp_va_grad[i * nSpace + 1] = gf_f_cache[eN].VA_y(i);
1932 gp_vb_grad[i * nSpace + 0] = gf_f_cache[eN].VB_x(i);
1933 gp_vb_grad[i * nSpace + 1] = gf_f_cache[eN].VB_y(i);
1934 }
1935 }
1936 else
1937 for (int i = 0; i < nDOF_trial_element * nSpace; i++)
1938 {
1939 gp_va_grad[i] = u_grad_trial_trace[i];
1940 gp_vb_grad[i] = u_grad_trial_trace[i];
1941 }
1942 // Which phases does this element actually carry? A face only gets a phase's penalty
1943 // if BOTH its elements have that phase, otherwise there is no extension to compare.
1944 phaseA_ok = phaseA_ok && (gp_icase == 0 || gp_icase == -1 || gp_icase == -2);
1945 phaseB_ok = phaseB_ok && (gp_icase == 0 || gp_icase == 1);
1946 for (int i = 0; i < nDOF_test_element; i++)
1947 {
1948 const int gp_dof = u_l2g.data()[eN * nDOF_trial_element + i];
1949 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++)
1950 {
1951 Dw_Dn_jump_a[gp_dof] += gp_va_grad[i * nSpace + I] * normal[I];
1952 Dw_Dn_jump_b[gp_dof] += gp_vb_grad[i * nSpace + I] * normal[I];
1953 }
1954 }
1955 {
1956 double gp_eu[nDOF_trial_element], gp_gua[nSpace] = {0., 0.}, gp_gub[nSpace] = {0., 0.};
1957 for (int i = 0; i < nDOF_trial_element; i++)
1958 gp_eu[i] = u_dof.data()[u_l2g.data()[eN_nDOF_trial_element + i]];
1959 ck.gradFromElementDOF(gp_eu, gp_va_grad, gp_gua);
1960 ck.gradFromElementDOF(gp_eu, gp_vb_grad, gp_gub);
1961 // Add the jump-lift gradient (grad_uja/grad_ujb): the ghost penalty must
1962 // compare the TOTAL branch field (u_a+u_ja / u_b+u_jb, see ga/gb ~line
1963 // 865-866) across the shared face, not the jump-free piece alone, or a
1964 // genuine prescribed solution jump reads as a spurious normal-derivative
1965 // kink between elements. Zero (no-op) unless eN is Gamma_f-cut.
1966 double gp_gja[nSpace] = {0., 0.}, gp_gjb[nSpace] = {0., 0.};
1967 ck.gradFromElementDOF(gp_JA, gp_va_grad, gp_gja);
1968 ck.gradFromElementDOF(gp_JB, gp_vb_grad, gp_gjb);
1969 if (gp_icase == 0) // flux-jump lift; set_boundary_quad(ebN_local_kb) is current
1970 {
1971 const double J = fluxLiftAmp[eN];
1972 gp_gja[0] += J * gf_f_cache[eN].PSIA_x();
1973 gp_gja[1] += J * gf_f_cache[eN].PSIA_y();
1974 gp_gjb[0] += J * gf_f_cache[eN].PSIB_x();
1975 gp_gjb[1] += J * gf_f_cache[eN].PSIB_y();
1976 }
1977 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++)
1978 {
1979 Du_Dn_jump_a += (gp_gua[I] + gp_gja[I]) * normal[I];
1980 Du_Dn_jump_b += (gp_gub[I] + gp_gjb[I]) * normal[I];
1981 }
1982 }
1983 } // eN_side
1984 if (phaseA_ok || phaseB_ok)
1985 {
1986 if (phaseA_ok)
1987 for (std::map<int, double>::iterator w_it = Dw_Dn_jump_a.begin(); w_it != Dw_Dn_jump_a.end(); ++w_it)
1988 globalResidual.data()[offset_u + stride_u * w_it->first] += gamma_cutfem * h_cutfem * Du_Dn_jump_a * w_it->second * dS;
1989 if (phaseB_ok)
1990 for (std::map<int, double>::iterator w_it = Dw_Dn_jump_b.begin(); w_it != Dw_Dn_jump_b.end(); ++w_it)
1991 globalResidual.data()[offset_u + stride_u * w_it->first] += gamma_cutfem * h_cutfem * Du_Dn_jump_b * w_it->second * dS;
1992 }
1993 else
1994 {
1995 // Neither phase is shared by both elements (Gamma_f runs along the face itself).
1996 // Keep the original combined penalty so the face is still stabilised.
1997 for (std::map<int, double>::iterator w_it = Dw_Dn_jump.begin(); w_it != Dw_Dn_jump.end(); ++w_it)
1998 globalResidual.data()[offset_u + stride_u * w_it->first] += gamma_cutfem * h_cutfem * Du_Dn_jump * w_it->second * dS;
1999 } // i
2000 } // kb
2001 ++it;
2002 }
2003 else
2004 {
2005 it = cutfem_boundaries.erase(it);
2006 }
2007 } // cutfem element boundaries
2008 // SCIFEM (Ji et al. 2014, eq. 3.7/3.8) symmetric consistency + adjoint-consistency terms
2009 // on cut edges: -switch*({{beta grad u}}.n_e*[[v]] + {{beta grad v}}.n_e*[[u]]).
2010 // A genuine 1D facet term -- the edge carries its own arc-length measure -- so no Dirac
2011 // surrogate is involved. The two region-wise integrands are formed separately and blended
2012 // by the edge Heaviside fit (see the prologue below), which is what makes this exact for
2013 // P1 and P2 without splitting the quadrature.
2014 for (std::set<int>::iterator it = ifem_boundaries.begin(); it != ifem_boundaries.end();)
2015 {
2016 if (elementIsActive[elementBoundaryElementsArray[(*it) * 2 + 0]] && elementIsActive[elementBoundaryElementsArray[(*it) * 2 + 1]])
2017 {
2018 int ebN = *it;
2019 int eN_s[2], ebN_local_s[2];
2020 for (int s = 0; s < 2; s++)
2021 {
2022 eN_s[s] = elementBoundaryElementsArray.data()[ebN * 2 + s];
2023 ebN_local_s[s] = elementBoundaryLocalElementBoundariesArray.data()[ebN * 2 + s];
2024 }
2025
2026 // --- Edge-restricted phi (both level sets) --------------------------------
2027 double edge_nodes[2][3], phi_edge[2], phi_s_edge[2];
2028 {
2029 const int n0l = (ebN_local_s[0] + 1) % 3, n1l = (ebN_local_s[0] + 2) % 3;
2030 const int ln[2] = {n0l, n1l};
2031 for (int e = 0; e < 2; e++)
2032 {
2033 int eN_i = eN_s[0] * nDOF_trial_element + ln[e];
2034 phi_edge[e] = immersedBoundary_sdf_nodes.data()[u_l2g.data()[eN_i]];
2035 phi_s_edge[e] = embeddedBoundary ? embeddedBoundary_sdf_nodes.data()[u_l2g.data()[eN_i]] : 1.0;
2036 for (int I = 0; I < 3; I++)
2037 edge_nodes[e][I] = mesh_dof.data()[u_l2g.data()[eN_i] * 3 + I];
2038 }
2039 }
2040 // edge diameter for the interior-penalty scaling (same measure the cutfem ghost
2041 // penalty uses); note gamma/h here for a VALUE jump, vs gamma*h there for a
2042 // gradient jump.
2043 const double h_edge = elementBoundaryDiameter.data()[ebN];
2044 double edge_vec[3];
2045 double edge_len2 = 0.0;
2046 for (int I = 0; I < 3; I++)
2047 {
2048 edge_vec[I] = edge_nodes[1][I] - edge_nodes[0][I];
2049 edge_len2 += edge_vec[I] * edge_vec[I];
2050 }
2051
2052 // --- Orientation map ------------------------------------------------------
2053 // The two elements sharing an interior face do NOT necessarily parametrize it in
2054 // the same direction, so quadrature index kb can denote DIFFERENT physical points
2055 // on the two sides (measured: 4 of 14 cut edges at test=8.0/refinement=1, with
2056 // exactly the mirror offsets |1-2t_k|*L of the Gauss rule). Pairing the sides by
2057 // raw kb then differences u at two different points, so [[u]] and {{beta grad u}}
2058 // pick up u's variation ALONG the edge instead of the genuine inter-element jump.
2059 // Build an explicit map instead: kmap[s][k] is side s's index for the physical
2060 // point that side 0 calls k. Matched by position, so no assumption about the
2061 // rule being symmetric or ascending.
2062 double xq[2][nQuadraturePoints_elementBoundary][3];
2063 for (int s = 0; s < 2; s++)
2064 for (int kb = 0; kb < nQuadraturePoints_elementBoundary; kb++)
2065 {
2066 double jac_t[nSpace * nSpace], jacDet_t, jacInv_t[nSpace * nSpace],
2067 bJac_t[nSpace * (nSpace - 1)], mT_t[(nSpace - 1) * (nSpace - 1)],
2068 mTDS_t, nrm_t[2], xt_ = 0.0, yt_ = 0.0, zt_ = 0.0;
2069 ck.calculateMapping_elementBoundary(eN_s[s], ebN_local_s[s], kb,
2070 ebN_local_s[s] * nQuadraturePoints_elementBoundary + kb,
2071 mesh_dof.data(), mesh_l2g.data(),
2072 mesh_trial_trace_ref.data(), mesh_grad_trial_trace_ref.data(),
2073 boundaryJac_ref.data(), jac_t, jacDet_t, jacInv_t,
2074 bJac_t, mT_t, mTDS_t, normal_ref.data(), nrm_t,
2075 xt_, yt_, zt_);
2076 xq[s][kb][0] = xt_; xq[s][kb][1] = yt_; xq[s][kb][2] = zt_;
2077 }
2078 // edge diameter: the length scale for the pairing tolerance just below,
2079 // and for the interior-penalty scaling further down (same measure the
2080 // cutfem ghost penalty uses); note gamma/h here for a VALUE jump, vs
2081 // gamma*h there for a gradient jump.
2082 // Match over nSpace components only: a component the mapping does not
2083 // define contributes nothing but noise to the distance, and the paired
2084 // points agree EXACTLY in the components it does define, so the winning
2085 // distance is 0 and the runner-up is a full quadrature spacing away.
2086 // Verify that outcome rather than trust it -- a mis-pick here silently
2087 // differences u at two different points, and assert() is compiled out by
2088 // the -DNDEBUG that reaches these translation units.
2089 int kmap[2][nQuadraturePoints_elementBoundary];
2090 bool kmap_used[nQuadraturePoints_elementBoundary] = {};
2091 for (int k = 0; k < nQuadraturePoints_elementBoundary; k++)
2092 {
2093 kmap[0][k] = k;
2094 int best = -1;
2095 double bestd = 1.0e300, nextd = 1.0e300;
2096 for (int j = 0; j < nQuadraturePoints_elementBoundary; j++)
2097 {
2098 double d = 0.0;
2099 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++) // the 2D mapping never writes z
2100 d += std::fabs(xq[1][j][I] - xq[0][k][I]);
2101 if (d < bestd) { nextd = bestd; bestd = d; best = j; }
2102 else if (d < nextd) { nextd = d; }
2103 }
2104 if (best < 0 || kmap_used[best] || bestd >= 1.0e-8 * h_edge || nextd <= 2.0 * bestd)
2105 {
2106 std::cerr << "ADR immersedSCIFEM: quadrature points on face " << ebN
2107 << " between elements " << eN_s[0] << " and " << eN_s[1]
2108 << " do not pair up (k=" << k << ", best=" << best
2109 << ", d=" << bestd << ", runner-up=" << nextd
2110 << ", h=" << h_edge << "); the mesh is non-conforming or the"
2111 << " boundary mapping is inconsistent." << std::endl;
2112 throw std::runtime_error("ADR immersedSCIFEM: face quadrature pairing failed");
2113 }
2114 kmap_used[best] = true;
2115 kmap[1][k] = best;
2116 }
2117
2118 // --- Edge Heaviside moment fit -------------------------------------------
2119 // The facet integrand is DISCONTINUOUS at the interface crossing theta, so a fixed
2120 // whole-edge Gauss rule cannot integrate it directly. Weight the two one-sided
2121 // integrands by an edge-restricted moment-fit Heaviside instead: exact for any
2122 // polynomial integrand of degree <= nP_edge, hence exact for P1 (degree <= 1) and
2123 // P2 (degree <= 3) alike -- no linearity assumption, unlike a split-quadrature
2124 // scheme. ONE fit per edge, in side 0's parametrization: the two sides' fits are
2125 // mirror images, moment-equivalent but not pointwise equal, so they must not be
2126 // mixed. t below is therefore always measured along side 0's edge direction.
2127 // Branch a = {phi_f<0}, branch b = {phi_f>0}, each intersected with the fluid side
2128 // {phi_s>0} (phi_s_edge is 1 without an embedded solid, so this is then exactly the
2129 // single Gamma_f fit and its complement).
2130 double C_a_edge[nP_edge + 1], C_b_edge[nP_edge + 1];
2131 equivalent_polynomials::calculate_edge_interval_H<nP_edge>(-phi_edge[0], -phi_edge[1], phi_s_edge[0], phi_s_edge[1], C_a_edge);
2132 equivalent_polynomials::calculate_edge_interval_H<nP_edge>(phi_edge[0], phi_edge[1], phi_s_edge[0], phi_s_edge[1], C_b_edge);
2133
2134 for (int k = 0; k < nQuadraturePoints_elementBoundary; k++)
2135 {
2136 double dS = 0.0;
2137 double ua_s[2], ub_s[2], flux_a_s[2], flux_b_s[2];
2138 std::map<int, double> va_m[2], vb_m[2], fta_m[2], ftb_m[2];
2139 for (int eN_side = 0; eN_side < 2; eN_side++)
2140 {
2141 int eN = eN_s[eN_side],
2142 ebN_local = ebN_local_s[eN_side],
2143 kb = kmap[eN_side][k],
2144 eN_nDOF_trial_element = eN * nDOF_trial_element,
2145 ebN_local_kb = ebN_local * nQuadraturePoints_elementBoundary + kb;
2146 double ua = 0.0, ub = 0.0,
2147 grad_ua[nSpace] = {0., 0.}, grad_ub[nSpace] = {0., 0.},
2148 jac_int[nSpace * nSpace], jacDet_int, jacInv_int[nSpace * nSpace],
2149 boundaryJac[nSpace * (nSpace - 1)],
2150 metricTensor[(nSpace - 1) * (nSpace - 1)], metricTensorDetSqrt,
2151 normal[2], x_int, y_int, z_int;
2152 ck.calculateMapping_elementBoundary(eN, ebN_local, kb, ebN_local_kb,
2153 mesh_dof.data(), mesh_l2g.data(),
2154 mesh_trial_trace_ref.data(), mesh_grad_trial_trace_ref.data(),
2155 boundaryJac_ref.data(), jac_int, jacDet_int, jacInv_int,
2156 boundaryJac, metricTensor, metricTensorDetSqrt,
2157 normal_ref.data(), normal, x_int, y_int, z_int);
2158 // dS and the reference normal n_e are fixed from side 0; side 1's own
2159 // outward normal is -n_e, which sign_ne converts back.
2160 if (eN_side == 0)
2161 dS = metricTensorDetSqrt * dS_ref.data()[kb];
2162 double sign_ne = (eN_side == 0) ? 1.0 : -1.0;
2163
2164 auto element_u = xt::pyarray<double>::from_shape({nDOF_trial_element});
2165 double element_phi_f[nDOF_trial_element], element_nodes[nDOF_trial_element * 3];
2166 for (int i = 0; i < nDOF_trial_element; i++)
2167 {
2168 int eN_i = eN * nDOF_trial_element + i;
2169 element_u.data()[i] = u_dof.data()[u_l2g.data()[eN_i]];
2170 element_phi_f[i] = immersedBoundary_sdf_nodes.data()[u_l2g.data()[eN_i]];
2171 for (int I = 0; I < 3; I++)
2172 element_nodes[i * 3 + I] = mesh_dof.data()[u_l2g.data()[eN_i] * 3 + I];
2173 }
2174 if (gf_f_boundary_gen[eN] != ifemGeometryGeneration)
2175 {
2176 gf_f_boundary_icase[eN] = gf_f_cache[eN].calculate(element_phi_f, element_nodes, xB_ref_faces, mua, mub, jf, true, false);
2177 gf_f_boundary_gen[eN] = ifemGeometryGeneration;
2178 }
2179 GfType &gf_f = gf_f_cache[eN];
2180 gf_f.set_boundary_quad(ebN_local_kb);
2181
2182 double va[nDOF_trial_element], va_grad_trial[nDOF_trial_element * nSpace],
2183 vb[nDOF_trial_element], vb_grad_trial[nDOF_trial_element * nSpace];
2184 for (int i = 0; i < nDOF_trial_element; i++)
2185 {
2186 va[i] = gf_f.VA(i);
2187 va_grad_trial[i * nSpace + 0] = gf_f.VA_x(i);
2188 va_grad_trial[i * nSpace + 1] = gf_f.VA_y(i);
2189 vb[i] = gf_f.VB(i);
2190 vb_grad_trial[i * nSpace + 0] = gf_f.VB_x(i);
2191 vb_grad_trial[i * nSpace + 1] = gf_f.VB_y(i);
2192 }
2193 // Solution-jump lift (same node pattern as assign_jump_side / the ghost penalty's
2194 // gp_JA/gp_JB): branch a is u + JA, branch b is u + JB. Without it the edge terms
2195 // see u^h instead of u^h + j_h and are inconsistent when [u] != 0.
2196 double ca_s[nDOF_trial_element], cb_s[nDOF_trial_element];
2197 for (int i = 0; i < nDOF_trial_element; i++)
2198 {
2199 ca_s[i] = element_u.data()[i];
2200 cb_s[i] = element_u.data()[i];
2201 }
2202 if (gf_f_boundary_icase[eN] == 0)
2203 {
2204 for (int i = 0; i < nDOF_trial_element; i++)
2205 {
2206 const double jump_i = immersedBoundary_solutionJump_nodes.data()[u_l2g.data()[eN * nDOF_trial_element + i]];
2207 if (element_phi_f[i] > 0.0)
2208 ca_s[i] -= jump_i;
2209 else
2210 cb_s[i] += jump_i;
2211 }
2212 }
2213 ck.valFromElementDOF(ca_s, va, ua);
2214 ck.gradFromElementDOF(ca_s, va_grad_trial, grad_ua);
2215 ck.valFromElementDOF(cb_s, vb, ub);
2216 ck.gradFromElementDOF(cb_s, vb_grad_trial, grad_ub);
2217 if (gf_f_boundary_icase[eN] == 0) // flux-jump lift, as for the solution jump
2218 {
2219 const double J = fluxLiftAmp[eN];
2220 ua += J * gf_f.PSIA();
2221 ub += J * gf_f.PSIB();
2222 grad_ua[0] += J * gf_f.PSIA_x();
2223 grad_ua[1] += J * gf_f.PSIA_y();
2224 grad_ub[0] += J * gf_f.PSIB_x();
2225 grad_ub[1] += J * gf_f.PSIB_y();
2226 }
2227
2228 ua_s[eN_side] = ua;
2229 ub_s[eN_side] = ub;
2230 double fa = 0.0, fb = 0.0;
2231 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++)
2232 {
2233 fa += mua * grad_ua[I] * normal[I];
2234 fb += mub * grad_ub[I] * normal[I];
2235 }
2236 flux_a_s[eN_side] = sign_ne * fa;
2237 flux_b_s[eN_side] = sign_ne * fb;
2238
2239 for (int i = 0; i < nDOF_test_element; i++)
2240 {
2241 int dof_i = u_l2g.data()[eN_nDOF_trial_element + i];
2242 va_m[eN_side][dof_i] = va[i];
2243 vb_m[eN_side][dof_i] = vb[i];
2244 double fta = 0.0, ftb = 0.0;
2245 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++)
2246 {
2247 fta += mua * va_grad_trial[i * nSpace + I] * normal[I];
2248 ftb += mub * vb_grad_trial[i * nSpace + I] * normal[I];
2249 }
2250 fta_m[eN_side][dof_i] = sign_ne * fta;
2251 ftb_m[eN_side][dof_i] = sign_ne * ftb;
2252 }
2253 } // eN_side
2254
2255 // t of this physical point along side 0's edge direction, then H_hat(t)
2256 double proj = 0.0;
2257 for (int I = 0; I < 3; I++)
2258 proj += (xq[0][k][I] - edge_nodes[0][I]) * edge_vec[I];
2259 double t_edge = (edge_len2 > 1.0e-24) ? (proj / edge_len2) : 0.0;
2260 // H_e / ImH_e: weights of branch b / branch a on its fluid piece of the edge
2261 double H_e = equivalent_polynomials::evaluate_edge_poly<nP_edge>(C_b_edge, t_edge);
2262 double ImH_e = equivalent_polynomials::evaluate_edge_poly<nP_edge>(C_a_edge, t_edge);
2263
2264 double avg_flux_a = 0.5 * (flux_a_s[0] + flux_a_s[1]);
2265 double avg_flux_b = 0.5 * (flux_b_s[0] + flux_b_s[1]);
2266 double jump_ua = ua_s[0] - ua_s[1];
2267 double jump_ub = ub_s[0] - ub_s[1];
2268
2269 // Blend the region-wise PRODUCTS, never the individual factors:
2270 // (ImH*A_f + H*B_f)*(ImH*A_v + H*B_v) != ImH*A_f*A_v + H*B_f*B_v.
2271 for (int side = 0; side < 2; side++)
2272 {
2273 double v_sign = (side == 0) ? 1.0 : -1.0;
2274 for (std::map<int, double>::iterator w = va_m[side].begin(); w != va_m[side].end(); ++w)
2275 {
2276 int dof_i = w->first;
2277 double jva_i = v_sign * va_m[side][dof_i], jvb_i = v_sign * vb_m[side][dof_i];
2278 double Pa = avg_flux_a * jva_i + 0.5 * fta_m[side][dof_i] * jump_ua;
2279 double Pb = avg_flux_b * jvb_i + 0.5 * ftb_m[side][dof_i] * jump_ub;
2280 globalResidual.data()[offset_u + stride_u * dof_i] -=
2281 immersedSCIFEM_switch * (ImH_e * Pa + H_e * Pb) * dS;
2282 // Interior-penalty stabilization gamma/h * int_e [[u]][[v]] ds. eq (3.7) is
2283 // consistency + adjoint only, so it carries no coercivity guarantee; this is
2284 // the standard remedy. Added with a PLUS sign (like the bulk stiffness) so it
2285 // is positive semi-definite, and blended by the same edge Heaviside so it
2286 // stays exact for P1 (integrand degree <= 2) and P2 (degree <= 4 = nP_edge).
2287 // Weighted by mu of each branch (like the Nitsche term), so the penalty is
2288 // of the size of the bulk term on both sides of a high-contrast interface.
2289 globalResidual.data()[offset_u + stride_u * dof_i] +=
2290 (immersedSCIFEM_penalty / h_edge) *
2291 (ImH_e * mua * jump_ua * jva_i + H_e * mub * jump_ub * jvb_i) * dS;
2292 }
2293 }
2294 } // k
2295 ++it;
2296 }
2297 else
2298 {
2299 it = ifem_boundaries.erase(it);
2300 }
