2677 u_grad_test_dV[j * nSpace + I] = u_grad_trial[j * nSpace + I] * dV; // cek warning won't work for Petrov-Galerkin
2678 //PGIFEM
2679 }
2680 }
2681 if (icase_f == 0)
2682 {
2683 double va[nDOF_trial_element], va_grad_trial[nDOF_trial_element * nSpace],
2684 vb[nDOF_trial_element], vb_grad_trial[nDOF_trial_element * nSpace];
2685 for (int i = 0; i < nDOF_trial_element; i++)
2686 {
2687 va[i] = gf_f.VA(i);
2688 va_grad_trial[i * nSpace + 0] = gf_f.VA_x(i);
2689 va_grad_trial[i * nSpace + 1] = gf_f.VA_y(i);
2690 vb[i] = gf_f.VB(i);
2691 vb_grad_trial[i * nSpace + 0] = gf_f.VB_x(i);
2692 vb_grad_trial[i * nSpace + 1] = gf_f.VB_y(i);
2693 }
2694 ck.valFromElementDOF(element_u.data(), va, ua);
2695 ck.gradFromElementDOF(element_u.data(), va_grad_trial, grad_ua);
2696 ck.valFromElementDOF(element_u.data(), vb, ub);
2697 ck.gradFromElementDOF(element_u.data(), vb_grad_trial, grad_ub);
2698 for (int i = 0; i < nDOF_test_element; i++)
2699 {
2700 ua_test_dV[i] = va[i] * dV;
2701 ub_test_dV[i] = vb[i] * dV;
2702 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++)
2703 {
2704 ua_grad_test_dV[i * nSpace + I] = va_grad_trial[i * nSpace + I] * dV;
2705 ub_grad_test_dV[i * nSpace + I] = vb_grad_trial[i * nSpace + I] * dV;
2706 }
2707 }
2708 for (int j = 0; j < nDOF_trial_element; j++)
2709 {
2710 ua_trial[j] = va[j];
2711 ub_trial[j] = vb[j];
2712 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++)
2713 {
2714 ua_grad_trial[j * nSpace + I] = va_grad_trial[j * nSpace + I];
2715 ub_grad_trial[j * nSpace + I] = vb_grad_trial[j * nSpace + I];
2716 }
2717 }
2718 if (PG)
2719 {
2720 // Same substitution as the residual; trial-side (j-index) arrays
2721 // are untouched, only the test side (i-index) changes.
2722 for (int i = 0; i < nDOF_test_element; i++)
2723 {
2724 ua_test_dV[i] = u_test_dV[i];
2725 ub_test_dV[i] = u_test_dV[i];
2726 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++)
2727 {
2728 ua_grad_test_dV[i * nSpace + I] = u_grad_test_dV[i * nSpace + I];
2729 ub_grad_test_dV[i * nSpace + I] = u_grad_test_dV[i * nSpace + I];
2730 }
2731 }
2732 }
2733 }
2734 //
2735 // calculate pde coefficients and derivatives at quadrature points
2736 //
2737 // evaluateCoefficients()
2738 a = &q_a.data()[eN_k * sd_rowptr.data()[nSpace]];
2739 // On a demoted element the fluid is entirely one phase, but the pre-evaluated
2740 // pointwise data still switches branch across the buried Gamma_f -- which lies inside
2741 // the solid part of this element. H_s is only moment-exact against polynomials, and a
2742 // coefficient that jumps mid-element is not one, so those quadrature points inject a
2743 // contribution from a fluid that is not physically present. Substitute the surviving
2744 // phase's constants, which makes the integrand polynomial again and H_s exact.
2745 double a_dem[nSpace * nSpace];
2746 double u_s_dem = embeddedBoundary_u_q.data()[eN_k];
2747 if (demoted_f != 0)
2748 {
2749 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace * nSpace; I++) a_dem[I] = 0.0;
2750 const double mu_dem = (demoted_f < 0) ? mua : mub;
2751 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++) a_dem[I * nSpace + I] = mu_dem;
2752 a = a_dem;
2753 u_s_dem = (demoted_f < 0) ? embeddedBoundary_u_inner_q.data()[eN_k]
2754 : embeddedBoundary_u_outer_q.data()[eN_k];
2755 }
2756 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++)
2757 df[I] = q_v.data()[eN_k * nSpace + I];
2758 dr = 0.0;
2759 const double H_s = gf_s.H(0., 0.);
2760 const double D_s = gf_s.D(0., 0.);
2761 // Per-side Dirac for the solid surface. Weighting the single-cut D_s by a region fit
2762 // (ImH_f * D_s) is the product-of-two-fits error again, and a large one -- about 31% on
2763 // the segment length. Declared here because the Nitsche terms below consume it.
2764 // Defaults to D_s, so elements cut by only one level set are untouched.
2765 double D_s_a = D_s, D_s_b = D_s;
2766 if (demoted_f != 0)
2767 {
2768 // The whole solid surface in this element borders the one surviving fluid region.
2769 D_s_a = (demoted_f < 0) ? D_s : 0.0;
2770 D_s_b = (demoted_f < 0) ? 0.0 : D_s;
2771 }
2772 else if (comp_DA != nullptr)
2773 {
2774 const double xr_d = x_ref.data()[k * 3 + 0], yr_d = x_ref.data()[k * 3 + 1];
2775 D_s_a = equivalent_polynomials::composite::evaluate<nP_fit>(comp_DA, xr_d, yr_d);
2776 D_s_b = equivalent_polynomials::composite::evaluate<nP_fit>(comp_DB, xr_d, yr_d);
2777 }
2778 if (embeddedBoundary)
2779 {
2780 double level_set_normal[nSpace];
2781 double sign = 0.0;
2782 double norm_exact = 0.0, norm_cut = 0.0;
2783 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++)
2784 {
2785 sign += embeddedBoundary_normal_q.data()[eN_k_3d + I] * gf_s.get_normal()[I];
2786 level_set_normal[I] = gf_s.get_normal()[I];
2787 norm_cut += level_set_normal[I] * level_set_normal[I];
2788 norm_exact += embeddedBoundary_normal_q.data()[eN_k_3d + I] * embeddedBoundary_normal_q.data()[eN_k_3d + I];
2789 }
2790 assert(std::fabs(1.0 - norm_cut) < 1.0e-8);
2791 assert(std::fabs(1.0 - norm_exact) < 1.0e-8);
2792 if (sign < 0.0)
2793 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++)
2794 level_set_normal[I] *= -1.0;
2795 if (icase_f == 0)
2796 {
2797 // The solution here is ua on the mua side and ub on the mub side; the plain `u` is
2798 // neither. Handing `u` to the penalty makes (u - u_s) nonzero even when the discrete
2799 // solution is exactly right, and the O(100/h) penalty amplifies that.
2800 // The prescribed jump is a constant offset with zero derivative, so it is
2801 // residual-only and does not appear here.
2802
2803 if (embeddedBoundary_robin)
2804 {
2805 updateEmbeddedBoundaryRobinTerms(embeddedBoundary_robin_h_inner,
2806 embeddedBoundary_robin_uInfinity_inner_q.data()[eN_k], ua, r_s_a, dr_s_a, D_s_a);
2807 updateEmbeddedBoundaryRobinTerms(embeddedBoundary_robin_h_outer,
2808 embeddedBoundary_robin_uInfinity_outer_q.data()[eN_k], ub, r_s_b, dr_s_b, D_s_b);
2809 }
2810 else
2811 {
2812 updateEmbeddedBoundaryTerms(embeddedBoundary_penalty / h_phi, dV, level_set_normal,
2813 embeddedBoundary_u_inner_q.data()[eN_k], ua, grad_ua, mua,
2814 r_s_a, dr_s_a, ham_s_a, dham_s_a, f_s_a, df_s_a, D_s_a);
2815 updateEmbeddedBoundaryTerms(embeddedBoundary_penalty / h_phi, dV, level_set_normal,
2816 embeddedBoundary_u_outer_q.data()[eN_k], ub, grad_ub, mub,
2817 r_s_b, dr_s_b, ham_s_b, dham_s_b, f_s_b, df_s_b, D_s_b);
2818 }
2819 }
2820 else
2821 {
2822 if (embeddedBoundary_robin)
2823 {
2824 const double h_here = (icase_f < 0) ? embeddedBoundary_robin_h_inner
2825 : embeddedBoundary_robin_h_outer;
2826 const double u_inf_here = (icase_f < 0)
2827 ? embeddedBoundary_robin_uInfinity_inner_q.data()[eN_k]
2828 : embeddedBoundary_robin_uInfinity_outer_q.data()[eN_k];
2829 updateEmbeddedBoundaryRobinTerms(h_here, u_inf_here, u, r_s, dr_s, D_s);
2830 }
2831 else
2832 {
2833 updateEmbeddedBoundaryTerms(embeddedBoundary_penalty / h_phi, dV, level_set_normal,
2834 u_s_dem, u, grad_u, a[0],
2835 r_s, dr_s, ham_s, dham_s, f_s, df_s, D_s);
2836 }
2837 }
2838 }
2839 const double ImH_f = gf_f.ImH(0., 0.);
2840 const double H_f = gf_f.H(0., 0.);
2841 // Region weights for the bulk terms. On an element cut by both level sets these
2842 // come from the composite fit; otherwise they are the usual products, unchanged.
2843 double wA = ImH_f * H_s, wB = H_f * H_s;
2844 if (demoted_f != 0)
2845 {
2846 // Only one fluid region exists here; give it the whole fluid weight and the other none.
2847 wA = (demoted_f < 0) ? H_s : 0.0;
2848 wB = (demoted_f < 0) ? 0.0 : H_s;
2849 }
2850 else if (comp_A != nullptr)
2851 {
2852 const double xr = x_ref.data()[k * 3 + 0], yr = x_ref.data()[k * 3 + 1];
2853 wA = equivalent_polynomials::composite::evaluate<nP_fit>(comp_A, xr, yr);
2854 wB = equivalent_polynomials::composite::evaluate<nP_fit>(comp_B, xr, yr);
2855 }
2856 double D_f = gf_f.D(0., 0.);
2857 if (comp_DFa != nullptr)
2858 {
2859 // Gamma_f's own Dirac measure, restricted to the part still inside the active
2860 // fluid domain (see comp_DFa_cache's declaration) -- the plain, single-curve
2861 // gf_f.D(0.,0.) above double-counts whatever part of Gamma_f's chord falls
2862 // inside Gamma_s's masked-out solid on a triply-cut element.
2863 const double xr_f = x_ref.data()[k * 3 + 0], yr_f = x_ref.data()[k * 3 + 1];
2864 D_f = equivalent_polynomials::composite::evaluate<nP_fit>(comp_DFa, xr_f, yr_f);
2865 }
2866 // A demoted element's Gamma_f lies entirely inside the solid: no part of it borders
2867 // fluid, so the flux-jump load must vanish exactly there (any fit would leave a
2868 // spurious source).
2869 if (demoted_f != 0)
2870 D_f = 0.0;
2871 if (immersedBoundary)
2872 {
2873 double level_set_normal[nSpace];
2874 double sign = 0.0;
2875 double norm_exact = 0.0, norm_cut = 0.0;
2876 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++)
2877 {
2878 sign += immersedBoundary_normal_q.data()[eN_k_3d + I] * gf_f.get_normal()[I];
2879 level_set_normal[I] = gf_f.get_normal()[I];
2880 norm_cut += level_set_normal[I] * level_set_normal[I];
2881 norm_exact += immersedBoundary_normal_q.data()[eN_k_3d + I] * immersedBoundary_normal_q.data()[eN_k_3d + I];
2882 }
2883 assert(std::fabs(1.0 - norm_cut) < 1.0e-8);
2884 assert(std::fabs(1.0 - norm_exact) < 1.0e-8);
2885 if (sign < 0.0)
2886 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++)
2887 level_set_normal[I] *= -1.0;
2888 updateImmersedBoundaryTerms(immersedBoundary_penalty / h_phi, // penalty,
2889 dV,
2890 level_set_normal,
2891 x,
2892 y,
2893 z,
2894 immersedBoundary_u_q.data()[eN_k],
2895 u,
2896 grad_u,
2897 a[0], // assume scalar diffusion for now
2898 r_f,
2899 dr_f,
2900 ham_f,
2901 dham_f,
2902 f_f,
2903 df_f,
2904 immersedBoundary_fluxJump_q.data()[eN_k],
2905 &immersedBoundary_fluxJumpVector_q.data()[eN_k_3d],
2906 // Gamma_f's jump physics only applies in the fluid: on an element that
2907 // sits (locally, at this quadrature point) entirely inside the embedded
2908 // solid, H_s==0 and D_f alone (gf_f.D, or the raw single-curve fallback
2909 // when comp_DFa isn't available) does not know that -- it only encodes
2910 // where Gamma_f itself is, not whether the fluid actually exists there.
2911 // Without this factor an element wholly inside the solid but crossed by
2912 // Gamma_f gets a fixed, u-independent Dirac source with nothing in the
2913 // Jacobian to balance it (the bulk terms are already correctly zero via
2914 // wA=wB=0), so Newton can never drive that row's residual to zero.
2915 // On a triply-cut cell comp_DFa is already restricted to the fluid part of
2916 // Gamma_f; multiplying it by the H_s fit again would restrict twice (a
2917 // product of two fits), so H_s is applied only to the single-curve D_f.
2918 (comp_DFa != nullptr) ? D_f : D_f * H_s);
2919 }
2920 //
2921 // calculate subgrid error contribution to the Jacobian (strong residual, adjoint, jacobian of strong residual)
2922 //
2923 // calculate the adjoint times the test functions
2924 for (int i = 0; i < nDOF_test_element; i++)
2925 {
2926 // int eN_k_i_nSpace = (eN_k*nDOF_trial_element+i)*nSpace;
2927 // Lstar_u[i]=ck.Advection_adjoint(df,&u_grad_test_dV.data()[eN_k_i_nSpace]);
2928 int i_nSpace = i * nSpace;
2929 Lstar_u[i] = ck.Advection_adjoint(df, &u_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]);
2930 }
2931 // calculate the Jacobian of strong residual
2932 for (int j = 0; j < nDOF_trial_element; j++)
2933 {
2934 // int eN_k_j=eN_k*nDOF_trial_element+j;
2935 // int eN_k_j_nSpace = eN_k_j*nSpace;
2936 int j_nSpace = j * nSpace;
2937 dpdeResidual_u_u[j] = ck.MassJacobian_strong(dm_t, u_trial_ref.data()[k * nDOF_trial_element + j]) +
2938 ck.AdvectionJacobian_strong(df, &u_grad_trial[j_nSpace]);
2939 }
2940 // tau and tau*Res
2941 calculateSubgridError_tau(elementDiameter.data()[eN],
2942 dm_t,
2943 df,
2944 cfl.data()[eN_k],
2945 tau0);
2946
2947 calculateSubgridError_tau(Ct_sge,
2948 G,
2949 dm_t,
2950 df,
2951 tau1,
2952 cfl.data()[eN_k]);
2953 tau = useMetrics * tau1 + (1.0 - useMetrics) * tau0;
2954
2955 for (int j = 0; j < nDOF_trial_element; j++)
2956 dsubgridError_u_u[j] = -tau * dpdeResidual_u_u[j];
2957
2958 // Leveque & Li 1994, Examples 1, 3, 4, PWC, PWL, PWQ
2959 double a_loc[nSpace * nSpace];
2960 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace * nSpace; I++) a_loc[I] = 0.0;
2961 for (int i = 0; i < nDOF_test_element; i++)
2962 {
2963 int i_nSpace = i * nSpace;
2964 for (int j = 0; j < nDOF_trial_element; j++)
2965 {
2966 int j_nSpace = j * nSpace;
2967 if (icase_f == 0)
2968 {
2969 if(!gf_f.exact.edge && !gf_f.exact.corner)
2970 {
2971 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++) a_loc[I * nSpace + I] = mua;
2972 elementJacobian_u_u.data()[i * nDOF_trial_element + j] += wA * (ck.AdvectionJacobian_weak(df, ua_trial[j], &ua_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]) +
2973 ck.SimpleDiffusionJacobian_weak(sd_rowptr.data(), sd_colind.data(), a_loc, &ua_grad_trial[j_nSpace], &ua_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]) +
2974 ck.ReactionJacobian_weak(dr + dr_f, ua_trial[j], ua_test_dV[i]) +
2975 ck.NumericalDiffusionJacobian(q_numDiff_u_last.data()[eN_k], &ua_grad_trial[j_nSpace], &ua_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]));
2976
2977 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++) a_loc[I * nSpace + I] = mub;
2978 elementJacobian_u_u.data()[i * nDOF_trial_element + j] += wB * (ck.AdvectionJacobian_weak(df, ub_trial[j], &ub_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]) +
2979 ck.SimpleDiffusionJacobian_weak(sd_rowptr.data(), sd_colind.data(), a_loc, &ub_grad_trial[j_nSpace], &ub_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]) +
2980 ck.ReactionJacobian_weak(dr + dr_f, ub_trial[j], ub_test_dV[i]) +
2981 ck.NumericalDiffusionJacobian(q_numDiff_u_last.data()[eN_k], &ub_grad_trial[j_nSpace], &ub_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]));
2982 }
2983 else if (gf_f.exact.edge == -1 || gf_f.exact.corner == -1)
2984 {
2985 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++) a_loc[I * nSpace + I] = mua;
2986 elementJacobian_u_u.data()[i * nDOF_trial_element + j] += wA * (ck.AdvectionJacobian_weak(df, ua_trial[j], &ua_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]) +
2987 ck.SimpleDiffusionJacobian_weak(sd_rowptr.data(), sd_colind.data(), a_loc, &ua_grad_trial[j_nSpace], &ua_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]) +
2988 ck.ReactionJacobian_weak(dr + dr_f, ua_trial[j], ua_test_dV[i]) +
2989 ck.NumericalDiffusionJacobian(q_numDiff_u_last.data()[eN_k], &ua_grad_trial[j_nSpace], &ua_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]));
2990 }
2991 else if (gf_f.exact.edge == 1 || gf_f.exact.corner == 1)
2992 {
2993 for (int I = 0; I < nSpace; I++) a_loc[I * nSpace + I] = mub;
2994 elementJacobian_u_u.data()[i * nDOF_trial_element + j] += wB * (ck.AdvectionJacobian_weak(df, ub_trial[j], &ub_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]) +
2995 ck.SimpleDiffusionJacobian_weak(sd_rowptr.data(), sd_colind.data(), a_loc, &ub_grad_trial[j_nSpace], &ub_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]) +
2996 ck.ReactionJacobian_weak(dr + dr_f, ub_trial[j], ub_test_dV[i]) +
2997 ck.NumericalDiffusionJacobian(q_numDiff_u_last.data()[eN_k], &ub_grad_trial[j_nSpace], &ub_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]));
2998 }
2999 else assert(false && "Invalid gf_f.exact.edge/corner values. Should be -1, 0 or +1.");
3000 }
3001 else
3002 {
3003 elementJacobian_u_u.data()[i * nDOF_trial_element + j] += H_s * (ck.AdvectionJacobian_weak(df, u_trial_ref.data()[k * nDOF_trial_element + j], &u_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]) +
3004 ck.SimpleDiffusionJacobian_weak(sd_rowptr.data(), sd_colind.data(), a, &u_grad_trial[j_nSpace], &u_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]) +
3005 ck.ReactionJacobian_weak(dr, u_trial_ref.data()[k * nDOF_trial_element + j], u_test_dV[i]) +
3006 ck.SubgridErrorJacobian(dsubgridError_u_u[j], Lstar_u[i]) +
3007 ck.NumericalDiffusionJacobian(q_numDiff_u_last.data()[eN_k], &u_grad_trial[j_nSpace], &u_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace]));
3008 }
3009 if (embeddedBoundary)
3010 {
3011 if (gf_s.exact.edge >=0 && !gf_s.exact.corner)
3012 {
3013 if (icase_f == 0)
3014 {
3015 elementJacobian_u_u.data()[i * nDOF_trial_element + j] +=
3016 (ck.AdvectionJacobian_weak(df_s_a, ua_trial[j], &ua_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace])
3017 + ck.ReactionJacobian_weak(dr_s_a, ua_trial[j], ua_test_dV[i])
3018 + ck.HamiltonianJacobian_weak(dham_s_a, &ua_grad_trial[j_nSpace], ua_test_dV[i])) +
3019 (ck.AdvectionJacobian_weak(df_s_b, ub_trial[j], &ub_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace])
3020 + ck.ReactionJacobian_weak(dr_s_b, ub_trial[j], ub_test_dV[i])
3021 + ck.HamiltonianJacobian_weak(dham_s_b, &ub_grad_trial[j_nSpace], ub_test_dV[i]));
3022 }
3023 else
3024 {
3025 elementJacobian_u_u.data()[i * nDOF_trial_element + j] += (ck.AdvectionJacobian_weak(df_s, u_trial_ref.data()[k * nDOF_trial_element + j], &u_grad_test_dV[i_nSpace])
3026 + ck.ReactionJacobian_weak(dr_s, u_trial_ref.data()[k * nDOF_trial_element + j], u_test_dV[i])
3027 + ck.HamiltonianJacobian_weak(dham_s, &u_grad_trial[j_nSpace], u_test_dV[i]));
3028 }
3029 }
3030 }
3031 // immersedBoundary's dr_f is folded into the wA/wB branch reaction terms
3032 // above (ck.ReactionJacobian_weak(dr + dr_f, ...)), matching the residual
3033 // restructuring -- see the comment there. dr_f/df_f/dham_f are always zero
3034 // (updateImmersedBoundaryTerms), so this was a no-op numerically either way,
3035 // but kept the wrong (unenriched) test function on the books.
3036 } // j
3037 } // i
3038 } // k
3039 }
3040
3041 void calculateJacobian(arguments_dict &args)
3042 {
3043 xt::pyarray<double> &mesh_trial_ref = args.array<double>("mesh_trial_ref");
3044 xt::pyarray<double> &mesh_grad_trial_ref = args.array<double>("mesh_grad_trial_ref");
3045 xt::pyarray<double> &mesh_dof = args.array<double>("mesh_dof");
3046 xt::pyarray<int> &mesh_l2g = args.array<int>("mesh_l2g");
3047 xt::pyarray<double> &dV_ref = args.array<double>("dV_ref");
3048 xt::pyarray<double> &u_trial_ref = args.array<double>("u_trial_ref");
3049 xt::pyarray<double> &u_grad_trial_ref = args.array<double>("u_grad_trial_ref");
3050 xt::pyarray<double> &u_test_ref = args.array<double>("u_test_ref");
3051 xt::pyarray<double> &u_grad_test_ref = args.array<double>("u_grad_test_ref");
3052 xt::pyarray<double> &elementDiameter = args.array<double>("elementDiameter");
3053 xt::pyarray<double> &cfl = args.array<double>("cfl");
3054 double Ct_sge = args.scalar<double>("Ct_sge");
3055 double sc_uref = args.scalar<double>("sc_uref");
3056 double sc_alpha = args.scalar<double>("sc_alpha");
3057 double useMetrics = args.scalar<double>("useMetrics");
3058 xt::pyarray<double> &mesh_trial_trace_ref = args.array<double>("mesh_trial_trace_ref");
3059 xt::pyarray<double> &mesh_grad_trial_trace_ref = args.array<double>("mesh_grad_trial_trace_ref");
3060 xt::pyarray<double> &dS_ref = args.array<double>("dS_ref");
3061 xt::pyarray<double> &u_trial_trace_ref = args.array<double>("u_trial_trace_ref");
3062 xt::pyarray<double> &u_grad_trial_trace_ref = args.array<double>("u_grad_trial_trace_ref");

3139 // loop over elements to compute volume integrals and load them into the element Jacobians and global Jacobian
3140 //
3141 // Coefficients.triplyCut_edgeFluidSide: take the fluid-side one-sided edge correction on
3142 // triply-cut cells (flips the sign of the correction in residual and Jacobian).
3143 const bool tcFluidMode = args.scalar<int>("triplyCut_edgeFluidSide");
3144 // Coefficients.triplyCut_edgeBoundaryOnly (use with SCIFEM on): keep the one-sided fluid-side
3145 // correction only on root-adjacent edges that lie on the exterior boundary. Interior ones are then
3146 // handled by SCIFEM's two-sided consistency term, which has no counterpart on an exterior edge.
3147 const bool tcBoundaryOnly = args.scalar<int>("triplyCut_edgeBoundaryOnly");
3148 const double tcSgn = tcFluidMode ? -1.0 : 1.0;
3149 // Per-face reference-ELEMENT quadrature points, taken from proteus' own trace tables.
3150 // Simplex::calculate(..., isBoundary=true) reads its xi_r argument as reference *element*
3151 // coordinates (it forms x = node0 + Jac_0*xi_r), but xB_ref holds reference *boundary*
3152 // points (t,0,0) -- passing those directly puts every face's points on the local
3153 // node0->node1 edge, i.e. correct only for local face 2. mesh_trial_trace_ref holds the P1
3154 // mesh shape functions at (face, quadrature point) and for a triangle those barycentric
3155 // functions ARE the reference coordinates (phi_0=1-xi-eta, phi_1=xi, phi_2=eta), so this
3156 // is exactly consistent with calculateMapping_elementBoundary's own convention.
3157 double xB_ref_faces[nDOF_mesh_trial_element * nQuadraturePoints_elementBoundary * 3];
3158 for (int f = 0; f < nDOF_mesh_trial_element; f++)
3159 for (int kb = 0; kb < nQuadraturePoints_elementBoundary; kb++)
3160 {
3161 const int fkb = f * nQuadraturePoints_elementBoundary + kb;
3162 const double *phi_m = &mesh_trial_trace_ref.data()[fkb * nDOF_mesh_trial_element];
3163 xB_ref_faces[fkb * 3 + 0] = phi_m[1];
3164 xB_ref_faces[fkb * 3 + 1] = phi_m[2];
3165 xB_ref_faces[fkb * 3 + 2] = 0.0;
3166 }
3167 for (int eN = 0; eN < nElements_global; eN++)
3168 {
3169 // double elementJacobian_u_u.data()[nDOF_test_element*nDOF_trial_element],element_u[nDOF_trial_element];
3170 auto elementJacobian_u_u = xt::pyarray<double>::from_shape({nDOF_test_element * nDOF_trial_element});
3171 auto element_u = xt::pyarray<double>::from_shape({nDOF_trial_element});
3172 for (int j = 0; j < nDOF_trial_element; j++)
3173 {
3174 int eN_j = eN * nDOF_trial_element + j;
3175 element_u.data()[j] = u_dof.data()[u_l2g.data()[eN_j]];
3176 }
3177 double element_phi_s[nDOF_trial_element];
3178 for (int j = 0; j < nDOF_trial_element; j++)
3179 {
3180 int eN_j = eN * nDOF_trial_element + j;
3181 element_phi_s[j] = embeddedBoundary_sdf_nodes.data()[u_l2g.data()[eN_j]];
3182 }
3183 double element_phi_f[nDOF_trial_element];
3184 for (int j = 0; j < nDOF_trial_element; j++)
3185 {
3186 int eN_j = eN * nDOF_trial_element + j;
3187 element_phi_f[j] = immersedBoundary_sdf_nodes.data()[u_l2g.data()[eN_j]];
3188 }
3189 double element_nodes[nDOF_trial_element * 3];
3190 for (int i = 0; i < nDOF_trial_element; i++)
3191 {
3192 int eN_i = eN * nDOF_trial_element + i;
3193 for (int I = 0; I < 3; I++)
3194 element_nodes[i * 3 + I] = mesh_dof.data()[u_l2g.data()[eN_i] * 3 + I];
3195 } // i
3196 if (gf_s_interior_gen[eN] != ifemGeometryGeneration)
3197 {
3198 gf_s_interior_icase[eN] = gf_s_cache[eN].calculate(element_phi_s, element_nodes, x_ref.data(), false);
3199 gf_s_interior_gen[eN] = ifemGeometryGeneration;
3200 }
3201 int icase_s = gf_s_interior_icase[eN];
3202 if (gf_f_interior_gen[eN] != ifemGeometryGeneration)
3203 {
3204 gf_f_interior_icase[eN] = gf_f_cache[eN].calculate(element_phi_f, element_nodes, x_ref.data(), mua, mub, jf, false, false);
3205 gf_f_interior_gen[eN] = ifemGeometryGeneration;
3206 }
3207 int icase_f = gf_f_interior_icase[eN];
3208 // Records that the buried-Gamma_f logic below demoted this element, and to which
3209 // phase: -1 = fluid is all Omega^- (mua), +1 = all Omega^+ (mub), 0 = not demoted.
3210 int demoted_f = 0;
3211 // Both level sets genuinely cut this element: the product weight ImH_f*H_s is not
3212 // moment-exact here, so fit one polynomial per intersected region instead. Any
3213 // element cut by at most one level set is left entirely alone.
3214 comp_valid[eN] = 0;
3215 comp_DF_valid[eN] = 0;
3216 if (icase_s == 0 && icase_f == 0 && nSpace == 2)
3217 {
3218 const double phi_s3[3] = {element_phi_s[0], element_phi_s[1], element_phi_s[2]};
3219 const double phi_f3[3] = {element_phi_f[0], element_phi_f[1], element_phi_f[2]};
3220 // The fluid interface can cross this element and still lie entirely inside the
3221 // solid, leaving the fluid undivided. There is then no fluid-fluid interface to
3222 // resolve *in the fluid*, so the two-sided IFEM reconstruction has nothing to
3223 // do -- and building it anyway means enforcing interface conditions along a
3224 // segment where no fluid exists. Demote the element to ordinary two-phase by
3225 // reporting the fluid's own side, which routes every downstream branch (bulk
3226 // terms, the solid's Nitsche condition, the error norm) to the standard basis.
3227 double areaA = 0.0, areaB = 0.0;
3228 equivalent_polynomials::composite::fluid_region_areas(phi_s3, phi_f3, areaA, areaB);
3229 // NOTE: we deliberately do NOT change icase_f here. Switching this element to the
3230 // standard basis would make it disagree with its neighbours about what their shared
3231 // DOFs mean: the neighbour (genuinely cut in the fluid) needs the pointwise nodal
3232 // value of u, while this element would need the surviving branch continued to all of
3233 // its nodes -- including nodes on the other side of Gamma_f. One DOF cannot be both,
3234 // so the exact solution would drop out of the discrete space entirely. Keeping the
3235 // IFEM basis costs nothing (u_ex satisfies the interface conditions globally, so
3236 // imposing them along a buried stretch of Gamma_f is harmless) and keeps the space
3237 // conforming. What we DO fix is the weights: the empty region must get exactly zero
3238 // rather than whatever a fit over an empty region would produce.
3239 //
3240 // Tolerance, not exact equality: a genuine tangency between Gamma_f and Gamma_s
3241 // (their zero-sets crossing exactly on a shared mesh edge) makes one region's true
3242 // area a single point, but floating-point roundoff in the clip almost never lands
3243 // on bit-exact 0.0 -- it lands a few ULPs away (observed: ~1e-33 against a
3244 // reference-triangle scale of 0.5). An exact-equality check misses that case
3245 // entirely and falls through to fitting a degree-4 polynomial to a numerically
3246 // degenerate sliver, which is unstable (observed: off by 64x on its own area).
3247 // areaTol is far above that roundoff floor and far below any physically meaningful
3248 // sub-area, so it can't misclassify a genuinely small-but-real fluid region.
3249 const double areaTol = 1.0e-9;
3250 if (areaB <= areaTol && areaA > areaTol)
3251 demoted_f = -1; // fluid is all Omega^- (mua side)
3252 else if (areaA <= areaTol && areaB > areaTol)
3253 demoted_f = 1; // fluid is all Omega^+ (mub side)
3254 else
3255 {
3256 const double nodes2[6] = {element_nodes[0], element_nodes[1],
3257 element_nodes[3], element_nodes[4],
3258 element_nodes[6], element_nodes[7]};
3259 comp_valid[eN] = (equivalent_polynomials::composite::weights<nP_fit>(
3260 phi_s3, phi_f3,
3261 &comp_A_cache[(std::size_t)eN * nCompMon],
3262 &comp_B_cache[(std::size_t)eN * nCompMon]) &&
3263 equivalent_polynomials::composite::dirac_weights<nP_fit>(
3264 phi_s3, phi_f3, nodes2,
3265 &comp_DA_cache[(std::size_t)eN * nCompMon],
3266 &comp_DB_cache[(std::size_t)eN * nCompMon])) ? 1 : 0;
3267 comp_DF_valid[eN] = equivalent_polynomials::composite::edge_weights<nP_fit>(
3268 phi_f3, phi_s3, nodes2,
3269 &comp_DFm_cache[(std::size_t)eN * nCompMon],
3270 &comp_DFa_cache[(std::size_t)eN * nCompMon]) ? 1 : 0;
3271 }
3272 }

3348 //
3349 for (int i = 0; i < nDOF_test_element; i++)
3350 {
3351 int eN_i = eN * nDOF_test_element + i;
3352 for (int j = 0; j < nDOF_trial_element; j++)
3353 {
3354 int eN_i_j = eN_i * nDOF_trial_element + j;
3355 globalJacobian.data()[csrRowIndeces_u_u.data()[eN_i] + csrColumnOffsets_u_u.data()[eN_i_j]] += elementJacobian_u_u.data()[i * nDOF_trial_element + j];
3356 } // j
3357 } // i
3358 // Jacobian of the correction above: exact 3x3 block, linear in u_dof through
3359 // the flux only. Same gate as the residual side, including the icase_s != -1 check.
3360 if (embeddedBoundary && immersedBoundary && (nDOF_trial_element == 3 || nDOF_trial_element == 6) && icase_f == 0
3361 && icase_s != -1)
3362 {
3363 // Same faces, quadrature and piece indicators as the residual side (P1 and P2).
3364 const int nD = nDOF_trial_element;
3365 bool neg[3] = {element_phi_f[0] < 0.0, element_phi_f[1] < 0.0, element_phi_f[2] < 0.0};
3366 int cnt_neg = (neg[0] ? 1 : 0) + (neg[1] ? 1 : 0) + (neg[2] ? 1 : 0);
3367 int root_i = -1;
3368 for (int ii = 0; ii < 3; ii++)
3369 if ((neg[ii] && cnt_neg == 1) || (!neg[ii] && cnt_neg == 2)) { root_i = ii; break; }
3370 if (root_i >= 0)
3371 {
3372 if (gf_f_boundary_gen[eN] != ifemGeometryGeneration)
3373 {
3374 gf_f_boundary_icase[eN] = gf_f_cache[eN].calculate(element_phi_f, element_nodes, xB_ref_faces, mua, mub, jf, true, false);
3375 gf_f_boundary_gen[eN] = ifemGeometryGeneration;
3376 }
3377 GfType &gf_f_tc = gf_f_cache[eN];
3378 const double sgn_s = tcFluidMode ? 1.0 : -1.0;
3379 for (int pj = 0; pj < 3; pj++)
3380 {
3381 if (pj == root_i)
3382 continue;
3383 const int ebN_tc = elementBoundariesArray.data()[eN * nDOF_mesh_trial_element + pj];
3384 if (tcBoundaryOnly && elementBoundaryElementsArray.data()[ebN_tc * 2 + 1] != -1)
3385 continue; // interior face: left to SCIFEM
3386 const int n0 = (pj + 1) % 3, n1 = (pj + 2) % 3;
3387 double C_a[nP_edge + 1], C_b[nP_edge + 1];
3388 equivalent_polynomials::calculate_edge_interval_H<nP_edge>(-element_phi_f[n0], -element_phi_f[n1],
3389 sgn_s * element_phi_s[n0], sgn_s * element_phi_s[n1], C_a);
3390 equivalent_polynomials::calculate_edge_interval_H<nP_edge>(element_phi_f[n0], element_phi_f[n1],
3391 sgn_s * element_phi_s[n0], sgn_s * element_phi_s[n1], C_b);
3392 const double ex0 = element_nodes[n0 * 3 + 0], ey0 = element_nodes[n0 * 3 + 1];
3393 const double evx = element_nodes[n1 * 3 + 0] - ex0, evy = element_nodes[n1 * 3 + 1] - ey0;
3394 const double elen2 = evx * evx + evy * evy;
3395 for (int kb = 0; kb < nQuadraturePoints_elementBoundary; kb++)
3396 {
3397 const int ebN_local_kb = pj * nQuadraturePoints_elementBoundary + kb;
3398 double jac_b[nSpace * nSpace], jacDet_b, jacInv_b[nSpace * nSpace],
3399 bJac_b[nSpace * (nSpace - 1)], mT_b[(nSpace - 1) * (nSpace - 1)], mTDS_b, n_b[2], xb, yb, zb;
3400 ck.calculateMapping_elementBoundary(eN, pj, kb, ebN_local_kb,
3401 mesh_dof.data(), mesh_l2g.data(),
3402 mesh_trial_trace_ref.data(), mesh_grad_trial_trace_ref.data(),
3403 boundaryJac_ref.data(), jac_b, jacDet_b, jacInv_b,
3404 bJac_b, mT_b, mTDS_b, normal_ref.data(), n_b, xb, yb, zb);
3405 const double dS = mTDS_b * dS_ref.data()[kb];
3406 const double t = ((xb - ex0) * evx + (yb - ey0) * evy) / elen2;
3407 const double Wa = equivalent_polynomials::evaluate_edge_poly<nP_edge>(C_a, t);
3408 const double Wb = equivalent_polynomials::evaluate_edge_poly<nP_edge>(C_b, t);
3409 gf_f_tc.set_boundary_quad(ebN_local_kb);
3410 for (int jj = 0; jj < nD; jj++)
3411 {
3412 const int eN_jj = eN * nDOF_test_element + jj;
3413 const double vA = gf_f_tc.VA(jj), vB = gf_f_tc.VB(jj);
3414 for (int kk = 0; kk < nD; kk++)

4031 inline cADR_base *newADR(int nSpaceIn,
4032 int nQuadraturePoints_elementIn,
4033 int nDOF_mesh_trial_elementIn,
4034 int nDOF_trial_elementIn,
4035 int nDOF_test_elementIn,
4036 int nQuadraturePoints_elementBoundaryIn,
4037 int CompKernelFlag)
4038 {
4039 // P2 with the degree-8 (16-point) triangle rule, qOrder 8: the rule that integrates the
4040 // degree-4 equivalent polynomials times the degree-4 Gamma_s integrands exactly. ADR-only,
4041 // so it is not added to the shared ModelFactory.
4042 if (nSpaceIn == 2 && CompKernelFlag == 0 && nDOF_mesh_trial_elementIn == 3 && nDOF_trial_elementIn == 6 &&
4043 nDOF_test_elementIn == 6 && nQuadraturePoints_elementIn == 16 && nQuadraturePoints_elementBoundaryIn == 8)
4044 return static_cast<cADR_base *>(new cADR<CompKernel<2, 3, 6, 6>, 2, 16, 3, 6, 6, 8>());
4045 if (nSpaceIn == 2)
4046 return proteus::chooseAndAllocateDiscretization2D<cADR_base, cADR, CompKernel>(nSpaceIn,
4047 nQuadraturePoints_elementIn,
4048 nDOF_mesh_trial_elementIn,
4049 nDOF_trial_elementIn,
4050 nDOF_test_elementIn,
4051 nQuadraturePoints_elementBoundaryIn,
4052 CompKernelFlag);
4053 else
4054 return proteus::chooseAndAllocateDiscretization<cADR_base, cADR, CompKernel>(nSpaceIn,
4055 nQuadraturePoints_elementIn,
4056 nDOF_mesh_trial_elementIn,
4057 nDOF_trial_elementIn,
4058 nDOF_test_elementIn,
4059 nQuadraturePoints_elementBoundaryIn,
4060 CompKernelFlag);
4061 }
